# PDS Admin III/Project Coordinator

AECOM

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/5147165820281316236?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6614898078958103393&crId=US_0US_0)

Company DescriptionWork with Us. Change the World.At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the worlds most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.Job DescriptionAECOM is seeking a PDS Administrative Assistant/Project Coordinator for one of our offices in Sacramento, CA. This role will be providing high-level administrative support. Skilled in coordinating multiple priorities in fast-paced environments, with strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving abilities. Demonstrates professionalism, adaptability, confidentiality, and a collaborative approach to supporting team operations and project success.Position Details:Filling, printing, calendaring, coordination, document quality control, other admin tasksLead complex and diverse administrative assignments seeing them from conception to completionSupport other administrative support staff as project continues to grow in size and scopeCoordinates conferences and/or events including meeting room reservations and logistics, A/V, meals, preparing meeting materials and can include attending the meetings and taking notes. Collaborating with other departments on special engagement projects. This could also entail some travel to meeting locationsProvide assistance with change management process and trackingMeets regularly with Task Lead to review status of projects; plan key events, meetings, and upcoming travel; and prioritize open action itemsCreates and maintains presentations, correspondence, reports, spreadsheets, and other necessary documents in response to and in anticipation of task lead needs. Maintains well-organized digital and hard copy files and records for efficient retrieval of data or information when neededInteracts and communicates with all levels within the PDS team as well as CHSRA; develops effective networks with peers, as well as external professional groupsAnticipate business needs, be proactive, troubleshoot problems and take initiativeManages and maintains calendar in Microsoft Outlook, including assisting with scheduling, within limits and at his/her discretion; applies understanding of priorities in scheduling meetingsEnsure that project correspondence and documentation are handled according to a prescribed formatSupport onboarding and offboarding processes and facilities coordination, including system access, workspace setup, projected and actual start dates, and activity trackingQualificationsMinimum requirements:BA/BS + 4 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.Strong proficiency and knowledge of computer software, including Microsoft Outlook, Teams Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Microsoft ExcelAbility to communicate effectively with audiences that include but are not limited to management, coworkers, clients, vendors, contractors, and visitorsJob related technical knowledge necessary to complete the jobAbility to attend to detail and work in a time-conscious and time-effectivePreferred Requirements:Experience composing and preparing correspondence and reportsDemonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills, and experienceExperience managing multiple and changing demands, details, and deadlinesAdditional InformationAt AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.About AECOMAECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com. What makes AECOM a great place to workYou will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. SummaryType: Full-timeFunction: AdministrativeExperience level: AssociateIndustry: Construction

### Job Description

Job Description

Company Description

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programmes as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include programme, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier programme, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Senior Scheduler to join our team to support scheduling as a project controls function on a large-scale project. The ideal individual will have a proven track record of successfully delivering construction project control services.

Responsibilities:

- Develop, monitor and update owners' Project Integrated Master Schedule (IMS).


- Establish the schedule management program and deliverables to be used on large scale capital programs.


- Interface with project stakeholders as trusted advisors to provide guidance and recommendations for the project.


- Prepare baseline schedules and schedule basis documents for approval by project teams.


- Conduct schedule of resource loading and leveling.


- Consolidate contractors schedule to incorporate into IMS.


- Assess impacts on the critical path and near-critical activities and report to the project team.


- Monitor schedule deviations and variances and assist in the development of alternative methods for corrective action.


- Apply EVM methodology to measure project progress.


- Review schedules with project team members on a regular basis to ensure that accurate and timely data is incorporated into the schedule.


- Prepare and provide schedule progress reports, trending charts, and schedule analysis on a periodic basis.


- Maintain record of scope changes, trends and variances that potentially affect schedule performance.


- Assure the credibility of the information contained in the schedule.


- Maintain liaison with clients and other consultants at all projects stages.


- SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.


Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in construction management, cost management, quantity surveying, engineering or field related to construction.


- Minimum 5-7 years of applicable experience.


- Direct experience working on teams within a complex matrix environment.


- Expertise using Primavera P6.


- Excellent communication skills.

About Ropes & Gray

Ropes & Gray is a preeminent global law firm. The firm has been ranked in the top three on The American Lawyer's prestigious A-List for eight consecutive years and #1 on Law.com's UK A-List twice in the past three years - rankings that honor the "best of the best" law firms.The firm has approximately 2,500 lawyers and professionals serving clients in major centers of business, finance, technology, and government in Boston, Chicago, Dublin, Hong Kong, London, Los Angeles, Milan, New York, Paris, San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, Silicon Valley, Singapore, Tokyo and Washington, D.C.The firm has consistently been recognized for its leading practices in many areas, including asset management, private equity, M&A, finance, real estate, tax, antitrust, life sciences, health care, intellectual property, litigation & enforcement, privacy & cybersecurity, and business restructuring.Ropes & Gray is an equal opportunity employer.

Overview

The Senior Billing Coordinator (SBC) is responsible for managing the unbilled and billed inventory for a portfolio of top revenue-producing clients and lawyers. This includes producing invoices for clients with complex billing arrangements, complying with applicable collection policies and adhering to outside counsel guidelines. The SBC will work closely with partners and their secretaries, other lawyers, client contacts and Finance staff to ensure the billing process is done in a timely and accurate manner and that client balances are paid on time.

Responsibilities

Manage the billing process for a select portfolio of high profile lawyers/clients including detailed knowledge of applicable client terms, discount arrangements and lawyer and client preferences. Specifically, the SBC will ensure:The billing process, from proformas to final billing is done accurately and timely in accordance to Firm standards and client guidelinesClient guidelines are documented, updated and complied withE-billing issues are identified and promptly resolved, including addressing rejected invoices as well as working with attorneys and their secretaries to obtain LEDES IDsManage the unbilled inventory as well as any billed invoices that require revision for the assigned group of lawyers/clients:Ensure consistent and regular communication with Billing Responsible Lawyers (BRLs) related to aged billed balancesLeverage secretaries and Finance management to escalate problem accountsMake recommendations for write-offs of aged balances where appropriateEnsure partners are achieving their billing incentives and the firm’s billing targetKeep matter arrangement coding current, including transactional codes and estimated bill datesClear temporary mattersSubmit write-offs over $10K for approvalUpdate proforma statuses and finalize invoices in accordance with firm processClear Bill on Account (BOA)Update Pricing team of any newly discovered alternative fee arrangements for review and ultimate dispositionAssist with the application of unidentified cash receipts Create and maintain documentation of procedures, deadlines and other client and lawyer preferences related to billingReview new matter notification emails and ensure matters in 3E are updated accordinglyRespond to information requests from lawyers, clients and administrative staff related to inventory levels, time and cost entries, billing reconciliations, outstanding receivables and cash receiptsSupport client and partner requests for accrual information that is timely and accurateOther related duties as assigned

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree preferredStrong analytical, critical thinking and effective communication skillsA minimum of five years’ experience in a professional services environment using time and billing software such as Elite or AderantProvide superior customer serviceDemonstrated proficiency with MS Excel, including advanced features such as vlookup, pivot tables and filtersSelf-directed with a strong work ethic; capable of working independently with limited supervisionAbility to occasionally work outside of established business hours and adjust personal schedule to meet deadlines is required

# Sr. Construction Scheduler (Level III)

Pacific Pros

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

### Job Description

Job Description

**Benefits:**

- 401(k)
- 401(k) matching
- Dental insurance
- Health insurance
- Paid time off
- Vision insurance

Pacific Pros is seeking **Construction Scheduler III** for **Construction Projects** to be a representative for Los Angeles World Airport (LAWA) shall be ultimately responsible for developing and maintaining detailed construction planning schedules for new construction and renovation work, as required for the Terminal Development & Improvement Program.  These schedules may incorporate several scenarios used to finalize construction sequencing and contracting plans.  These projects may include but are not limited to: Airline Terminal Improvement projects, Airport Service Improvement projects, Terminal Development projects and Asset Renewal.

Note: Construction Schedulers with less experience may be needed in the near future. Candidates are welcome to contact Pacific Pros for consideration for the upcoming opportunities.

**Work Location: LAWA has required the candidates be local for this position** .

**Region: Los Angeles, CA**

**Status: Full-time on-site.**

**Opening: Winter 2024, Immediate**

**Position Description Summary**

Participate as integral member of an owner’s program and project controls team, being directly responsible for scheduling multiple, interdependent projects of a large scale ($100m+ in value).  Work collaboratively with other elements of the owner’s team, including project managers, construction managers, other controls discipline leads, and claims staff to monitor, report on, and negotiate issues on assigned projects.  Review designer and contractor submitted schedules and perform analysis as needed.

Provide owner with objective assessments of schedule delays (using Time Impact Analysis or other means), present summary and detailed findings to owner and/or third parties as needed. Engage in direct discussions with contractor, as needed, to understand basis of delay claims and support owner’s understanding of potential liabilities for the negotiation of appropriate settlements.

**Essential Job Duties for this position**

The duties for this position include, but are not limited to, the following:

- Review Contractor’s Baseline Construction Schedule for conformance with the Plans and Specification to ensuring proper WBS breakdown, sequencing, critical path and logic ties, and inclusion of all activities, resource loading, etc. necessary for approval.
 - Perform and coordinate constructability review on Contractor’s Baseline Schedule submittal and identify any missing activities, float sequestering or suppression techniques/issues or any other conflicts or shortcomings.
 - Ensure that project WBS are properly coded and resource loaded.
 - Provide written evaluation, comments and responses on Baseline Schedule submittal.
- Review Contractor’s Monthly Schedule updates in conformance with the plans and specification and identifying any logic changes or inaccurate progress reporting, critical path changes or other pertinent items necessary.
 - Identify variations from the plan and analyses and report on the cause of the variations.
 - Review construction progress and inspection reports and maintain an accurate “as built” schedule for use during construction and for evaluation of Contractor’s Monthly Schedule updates and any Time Impact Analysis (TIA) submittal.
 - Attend weekly construction meeting and monitor 3 Week Look Ahead Schedules for accuracy and identify any inconsistency with Baseline/Schedule updates. Promptly reporting schedule slippage, other unsatisfactory performance or other variances.
 - Identify any critical path changes or near critical path changes that could impact individual phase, milestones or project duration.
 - Provide written response and approval recommendation submittal response.
 - Coordinate schedule comments and corrections with Contractors.
 - Schedule deficiencies.
- Maintain a Owner shadow Schedule identifying actual construction activities dates from various sources including daily inspection and quality control reports, site visits, etc.  Project and identify potential delays or schedule adjustments based upon Owner Schedule and utilize to assist in evaluating the Contractor’s Monthly Schedule updates.
- Review Time Impact Analysis (TIA) submitted by the Contractor and provide written responses, evaluation and recommendation for time extension as appropriate.  Identify schedule variances and opportunities and proactively develop mitigation strategies for the Project Management team.
- Provide LAWA “What if” schedule impacts for contemplated additional work, potential re-sequencing of phases or construction activities. Evaluate, and forecast project status against an established baseline schedule. Assess the impact of project milestones and report status to Management in order to mitigate project overruns and schedule slippage.
- Provides direct scheduling related support on multiple projects on reporting to multiple Project Managers.
- May require monthly support for projects in Planning or Design along with supporting Construction projects within a Master Program Schedule Plan and would report to the Airside Element Management Team.
- May be required to maintain master schedule system to track project interfaces for time frame impacts to electrical airfield systems, mechanical systems, airfield operations and other aviation related disciplines and projects.
- Provides development and analysis of man-hour resources, equipment resources and cost loaded, time-phased schedules.
- Prepare detailed plans; time scaled charts, diagrams and tracking various quantities to measure construction performance.
- Maintain simplified logic schedules to highlight status of key interfaces for critical path review.
- Provide progress reporting documents and briefing materials as required. Develop creative reporting tools to communicate complex project sequencing and/or progress assessments.
- Participate and review with third-party schedulers to address and provide written comments.
- Analyze and assess project milestones and reports the fiscal impact and risk to Management.
- Contribute to the advancement of PDG’s goals through commitment to productive collaboration with all stakeholders and in development of planning and design schedules.
- Support overlapping project scheduling tasks, issue management, meeting facilitation, document control and monthly status reporting to the Project Management Team.

**Hardware/Software Knowledge**

- Mastery of Oracle Primavera P6 Version 8.3 or higher.
- Experience with Microsoft Office Suite software – Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
- Knowledge of Prolog and other Project Management Systems is preferred.
- Experience with Adobe Acrobat.
- Knowledgeable of presenting graphical data as related to scheduling.
- Use of other related software tools such as Schedule Analyzer, MS Project, Claim Digger, etc.

**Required Qualifications**

- US Employment Authorization without needing sponsorship
- See Education/Training requirements
- Excellent written and oral communication skills
- A valid Driver’s License and compliance with PACIFIC’s Vehicle Policy
- Proficiency with common Microsoft Office Applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook), SharePoint and Adobe Acrobat (PDF files)
- 3+ References from Clients
- **10 years or more of scheduling experience with 5+ years in direct support of an active construction project**
- Demonstrated experience scheduling the design and construction of large-scale, complex projects including developing and managing a progress reporting methodology for multi-million-dollar construction projects within the range of $30M – $150M.
- Requires knowledge and experience of Project Management principles and Project Control Cycles.
- Must be capable of reporting earned value performance measurement techniques.
- Understanding of critical path method (CPM) scheduling techniques and principles, including ability to handle and prioritize multiple projects concurrently.
- Must be able to track field progress weekly in reporting Contractor’s performance.
- Developed reporting tools to communicate complex project sequencing and/or progress assessments.
- Worked in a master schedule/sub project system environment including programs in determining progress impacts.
- Must possess capability to report on all levels of project schedules, quality, monitor project progress, risk and ensure project milestones are met.
- Demonstrated experience in working and reviewing third-party design and/or construction schedules and addressing comments.
- Must clearly and concisely be capable of presenting project trends, risks and forecast performance reports to management and to make recommendations on strategies and mitigation measures to resolve project issues is required.
- Demonstrated experience in progress reporting documents and ability to understand a demanding, technical and complicated construction program plus the ability to communicate progress and issues both verbally and written communications on technical and non-technical matters for various levels of management.
- Demonstrated success on the job, as evidenced by satisfactory performance, acceptance of responsibility, and growth in previous position(s).
- Must possess the ability to effectively interact with various departments to maintain open lines of communication.
- Proven accuracy, reliability and completeness in job accomplishment.
- Self-starter with results-driven focus and ability to work with others.

**Education/Training**

- A Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management or related field is preferred.

**Registration/Certification**

- Planning and Scheduling Professional (PSP) certification is preferred.

**Element-Specific Requirements/Notes**

- Aviation experience preferred.
- May assume other duties as required/needed
- Maybe required to work past regular work shift
- Maybe required to work various shifts as needed

# Senior Executive Assistant

$150k

Doen

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-8419563591745484671?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-2295646063928600562&crId=US_0US_0)

**Company Overview**

Founded by Santa Barbara-born sisters, Margaret and Katherine Kleveland, and a Collective of partners, DÔEN was launched in 2016 and is a digitally-led, multi-channel fashion and lifestyle brand. Our mission is to create lasting, beautiful collections while supporting individuals in all aspects of the organization, supply chain, and community. We work with domestic and international partners who share our values and commitment to gender and social equality, and we give back by partnering with foundations that directly benefit our employees, value chain, and surrounding communities.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

**Title:** Senior Executive Assistant

**Location:** Los Angeles, CA (Van Nuys area)

**Schedule:** Full-time, In-Person

**Classification:** Exempt

**Salary \*** : $150,000 yearly

**Overview**

DÔEN is seeking an exceptional Senior Executive Assistant to support the CEO and CCO and directly manage at least one administrative professional. This role requires a highly skilled individual who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and brings extensive experience supporting senior executives in high-demand settings.

The ideal candidate is an exceptionally quick thinker who processes information rapidly, anticipates needs, and translates direction into action with minimal oversight. They possess outstanding organizational and prioritization skills, sound judgment, and strong business acumen, with the ability to navigate competing demands while understanding the company's broader priorities. They are highly detail-oriented, exercise absolute discretion with confidential information, and demonstrate the leadership skills and strategic thinking necessary to operate as a trusted partner to executive leadership.

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

**Executive Support**

- Serve as trusted support to the CEO and CCO, managing complex calendars, inbox management/strategy, priorities, and sensitive communications.
- Anticipate needs and proactively address challenges before they arise, exercising independent judgment on matters of significance.
- Prepare the CEO and CCO for meetings with comprehensive briefing materials, agendas, and background research.
- Attend key meetings, taking exceptionally thorough and accurate notes, capturing decisions, action items, and ensuring timely follow-through.
- Quickly synthesize information, translating verbal direction into action with minimal need for clarification.
- Manage CEO and CCO correspondence, screening, and prioritizing communications while drafting responses on behalf of leadership.
- Exercise sound judgment in prioritizing competing requests, recognizing business-critical matters and ensuring executive attention is directed toward the highest-impact priorities.
- Developing a fluent and ongoing understanding of technology platforms across various functions (HR, Finance, Supply Chain, Operations).
- Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements, including detailed itineraries and logistics.
- Handle confidential information with the utmost discretion and professionalism.

**Management & Leadership**

- Directly manage and mentor a team of at least one Administrative Assistant.
- Set performance objectives, conduct evaluations, and provide ongoing coaching and professional development.
- Delegate tasks effectively to optimize efficiency and workload balance, ensuring accountability, accuracy, and timely execution.
- Implement and refine administrative processes to improve efficiency, streamline workflows, and proactively address operational challenges.
- Develop a strong understanding of the company's business model, key revenue-driving functions, and operational priorities to effectively anticipate executive needs and prioritize work accordingly.

**Strategic Operations**

- Manage special projects and initiatives on behalf of executive leadership, coordinating cross-functional teams and ensuring projects move forward efficiently with minimal oversight.
- Prepare reports, presentations, and analyses to support executive decision-making.
- Serve as liaison between executives and internal/external stakeholders, representing leadership in meetings when appropriate.
- Plan and execute board meetings, leadership offsites, and company-wide events.
- Monitor budget expenditures and manage expense reporting for the executive office.

**Organizational Leadership**

- Act as a gatekeeper and as an ambassador of company values, setting the tone for professionalism and excellence.
- Build relationships across all levels of the organization to facilitate collaboration and information flow.
- Identify opportunities for operational improvements and drive effective implementation.

**Qualifications:**

**Required**

- 10+ years of experience supporting C-suite executives, ideally founders, CEOs, or other high-level executives in demanding, fast-paced, and creative environments.
- 3+ years of people management experience, with proven ability to develop high-performing teams.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
- Expert-level proficiency in Google Workspace and project management tools.
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with impeccable attention to detail.
- Demonstrated ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining composure under pressure, quickly shifting between tasks, processing new information, and adapting to changing priorities without sacrificing accuracy or follow-through..
- Strong business acumen with an understanding of corporate operations and strategic planning, including the ability to recognize business-critical priorities and exercise sound judgment in allocating time and resources.
- Absolute discretion and ability to handle highly confidential information.

**Preferred**

- Experience in apparel, beauty, entertainment, or similar fast-paced creative environments.
- Advanced skills in data analysis, financial reporting, or presentation design.
- Experience managing executive communications during organizational change.
- Prior experience supporting high-profile executives, founders, or senior leaders in complex, high-pressure environments.

\\* Compensation will be determined based on experience and other factors permitted by law.

##### Senior Accounts Payable Clerk

Pennymac (NYSE: PFSI) is a specialty financial services firm with a comprehensive mortgage platform and integrated business focused on the production and servicing of U.S. mortgage loans and the management of investments related to the U.S. mortgage market. At Pennymac, our people are the foundation of our success and at the heart of our dynamic work culture. Together, we work towards a unified goal of helping millions of Americans achieve aspirations of homeownership through the complete mortgage journey.

A Typical Day Responsible for executing end-to-end Accounts Payable operations across all legal entities. Core responsibilities include PO & Non-PO invoice processing, corporate card expense report creation, understanding intercompany allocations, prepaid expense, capitalized expense, processing weekly payment requests, month-end accruals, vendor account reconciliations, annual 1099 tax compliance reporting and other duties as assigned.

Core AP Operations & Invoice Processing

- Maintain supplier setup and maintenance, inclusive of working with Treasury team for bank account validation for electronic payments.
- Prepare Stop Payment requests using Treasury system ensuring all research has been completed and proper documentation is attached in Treasury and ERP systems.
- Process and audit incoming vendor invoices, check requests, and corporate card expense reports for policy compliance and accurate GL/entity coding.
- Perform 3-way matching between vendor invoices, Purchase Orders (POs), and receiving reports; investigate and resolve pricing/quantity variances before posting.
- Post all approved AP transactions to the sub-ledger and ensure timely payment runs (checks, ACH, wire transfers), adhering to vendor payment terms.
- Obtain required managerial and executive approval thresholds across all departments and legal entities based on AP Approval Matrix
- Ensure all incoming invoices are processed by reviewing aging reports, scan queues, and Accounts Payable email.

Tax Compliance & Vendor Onboarding

- Manage vendor onboarding by collecting and validating W-9 forms and verifying Taxpayer Identification Numbers (TIN).
- Maintain 1099-eligible vendor profiles and track payments throughout the fiscal year.
- Lead annual 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC filing processes, threshold reviews, and year-end tax reporting.

Multi-Entity & Intercompany Processing, Month-End Close

- Perform accounts payable functions across all legal entities
- Allocate shared vendor expenses across entities via invoice GL coding.
- Collaborate with Accounting team and lines of business to review vendor historical trend to support estimated and calculated unbilled month-end AP accruals.
- Reconcile the AP sub-ledger to the General Ledger (GL) and complete monthly balance sheet reconciliation.
- Assist with month-end and year-end close schedules by preparing AP Control reports for management review.

Communication & Reporting

- Serve as the primary contact for offshore team, vendors and internal stakeholders, resolving payment inquiries, invoice holds, and billing disputes diplomatically.
- Generate ad hoc AP and expense analysis reports for lines of business and executive leadership as requested.

What You'll Bring

- Experience: 3–4 years of full-cycle Accounts Payable experience handling high-volume processing in a multi-entity environment.
- Industry Experience: Mortgage Industry and/or Financial Services experience strongly preferred.
- Accounting Software: Hands-on proficiency in ERP systems (Oracle, or equivalent enterprise ERP).
- Technology: Skilled on workflow automation and efficiency.
- Excel Competency: Intermediate-to-advanced MS Excel skills required (must be comfortable using Pivot, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and SUMIFS for reconciliations).
- Tax knowledge: Strong working knowledge of W-9 validation rules and hands-on experience with 1099-NEC/MISC year-end filings.
- Analytical Skills: Excellent critical thinking, mathematical accuracy, and problem-solving skills to independently research variances and GL discrepancies.
- Professional Attributes: High attention to detail, team player with strong business acumen, and excellent verbal/written communication skills when interfacing with vendors and executive management.
- Flexibility: Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and work extended hours during peak period closes.
- Proven track record at delivering timely and accurate information in a fast-paced environment.

Why You Should Join

As one of the top mortgage lenders in the country, Pennymac has helped over 4 million lifetime homeowners achieve and sustain their aspirations of home. Our vision is to be the most trusted partner for home. Together, 4,000 Pennymac team members across the country are guided by our core values: to be Accountable, Reliable and Ethical in all that we do. Pennymac is committed to conducting a business that makes positive contributions and promotes long-term sustainable growth and to fostering an equitable and inclusive environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported.

Benefits That Bring It Home: Whether you're looking for flexible benefits for today, setting up short-term goals for tomorrow, or planning for long-term success and retirement, Pennymac's benefits have you covered. Some key benefits include: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Paid Time Off Programs including vacation, holidays, illness, and parental leave Wellness Programs, Employee Recognition Programs, and onsite gyms and cafe style dining (select locations) Retirement benefits, life insurance, 401k match, and tuition reimbursement Philanthropy Programs including matching gifts, volunteer grants, charitable grants and corporate sponsorships To learn more about our benefits visit: For residents with state required benefit information, additional information can be found at: Compensation: Individual salary may vary based on multiple factors including specific role, geographic location / market data, and skills and experience as defined below: Lower in range - Building skills and experience in the role Mid-range - Experience and skills align with proficiency in the role Higher in range - Experience and skills add value above typical requirements of the role Some roles may be eligible for performance-based compensation and/or stock-based incentives awarded to employees based on company and individual performance. Founded in 2022, SpeedX offers a superior last-mile delivery experience designed to better connect brands to customers. At SpeedX, we’re more than just a delivery company – we’re partners in success. We believe that ecommerce delivery shouldn’t be a hassle, a financial strain, or a source of stress for businesses. We created a next-level delivery experience that’s designed to meet business's needs, exceed their expectations, and future-proof their ecommerce business.
In just three years of business, we have grown our client list to over a dozen online marketplaces, 3PLs and direct retailers and are now delivering over 300,000 packages daily worldwide – with the number constantly growing. And we have no plans of slowing down!
Job Summary We are seeking an experienced and analytical Senior Total Rewards & Payroll Specialist to support the company’s compensation, benefits, payroll, and performance management programs. The Senior Total Rewards & Payroll Specialist is responsible for the end-to-end administration of SpeedX’s total rewards programs, including payroll, benefits, and compensation. This role blends payroll expertise with total rewards management, requiring both technical precision and strategic insight to support employee satisfaction and compliance. This role ensures accuracy, compliance, and positive employee experience across all reward functions, while partnering with HR, finance, and external vendors to optimize processes.
Key Responsibilities: Payroll & Pay Administration Process accurate, timely bi-weekly or semi-monthly payrolls for multiple states and locations.
Review, reconcile, and validate timecard data, time-off transactions, and payroll previews before submission.
Maintain employee payroll records, including pay changes, deductions, and direct deposit updates.
Process separation pays, garnishments, and other special payroll transactions in compliance with laws.
Review quarterly and annual tax reporting, including W‑2s and 1099s.
Benefits & Leave Administration Administer core and ancillary benefits (health, welfare, retirement, charitable giving, etc.).
Manage open enrollment, benefit changes, and leave of absence processing.
Support 401(k) and other retirement plan administration.
Compensation & Total Rewards Support annual compensation reviews and benchmarking.
Provide pay structure recommendations and job-specific pay analysis.
Collaborate with HR and finance to ensure pay equity and compliance.
Partner with HRIS (Rippling) and payroll/benefits vendors to resolve issues and maintain strong relationships.
Optimize processes, reduce errors, and improve efficiency.
Provide ad-hoc reporting and analytics to management.
Skills & Attributes High attention to detail and accuracy.
Strong organizational and time management skills.
Ability to handle multiple priorities and meet deadlines.
Collaborative and employee-focused mindset.
Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Business, HR, or related field preferred.
5+ years’ experience in payroll, benefits, and/or compensation administration.
Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local payroll tax laws.
Proficiency with HRIS and payroll software (e.g., Rippling, ADP).
Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) or similar certification preferred.
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills; ability to work independently and in a fast-paced environment.
Prior experience within logistics, manufacturing, warehouse operations, transportation, or supply chain industries is highly preferred.

Job Description

**About Us**

We are a dynamic SaaS company building innovative software solutions that make a difference in the Environmental Health Risk and Safety industry. Our collaborative team is passionate about technology and committed to excellence. We are looking for a talented Information Technology Manager to join our team in San Diego, CA and help drive our technical vision forward.

**\*\*THIS IS AN ON-SITE POSITION IN SAN DIEGO, CA 92127.\*\***

_Important Note: This is a full-time, on-site with benefits role in San Diego,CA. We are only considering local candidates at this time. Relocation assistance is not available._

- Competitive Salary Range: $65,000-$75,000 per year DOE

**The Opportunity**

The Senior Bookkeeper is responsible for managing the company's complete day-to-day financial operations, combining full-cycle bookkeeping with accounting specialist functions including 3rd party billing, financial reporting, and corporate compliance. This is a high-ownership, self-directed role within a small, collaborative SaaS team, working directly with management. The incoming employee will benefit from a paid transition overlap with the outgoing bookkeeper with a hands-on knowledge transfer covering all systems, processes, vendor relationships, and compliance responsibilities before assuming full independent ownership.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

Core Bookkeeping

- Manage day-to-day bookkeeping functions, including accurate recording of financial transactions and maintenance of supporting documentation.
- Maintain corporate books including cash receipts, purchase, sales, general, and cash disbursement journals.
- Post bills to journal, process invoices, and balance journals on a regular schedule.
- Operate QuickBooks to record, store, and analyze financial data.
- Collect, enter, or download financial data from internal and external sources; review for accuracy prior to posting.
- Organize and maintain work papers, financial documents, and supporting records; file and retrieve as needed.

Accounts Receivable & 3rd Party Billing

- Administer accounts receivable processes, including 3rd party billing, invoice tracking, and follow-up on outstanding balances.
- Submit and manage billing through client portals including Coupa, Ariba, and/or ESIC depending on client platform requirements.
- Correspond directly with external billing contacts and clients to resolve billing inquiries, disputes, and outstanding balances.
- Make collection calls and emails, post payments, and record corresponding journal entries.
- Prepare and maintain AR aging reports; escalate delinquent accounts as needed.

Accounts Payable

- Oversee accounts payable activities by reviewing invoices, preparing payments, and ensuring obligations are settled within expected timelines.
- Process check runs and vendor payments; prepare signature-ready checks.
- Maintain organized AP files, vendor records, and supporting documentation.

Bank & Account Reconciliations

- Perform bank and account reconciliations — including credit cards, petty cash, and loans — to confirm financial records are complete, balanced, and up to date.
- Prepare bank deposits; identify and escalate discrepancies promptly.
- Administer general ledger coding, postings, and documentation to ensure correct entry and audit-ready records.

Payroll

- Process company bi-weekly payroll using ADP Workforce Now with a high level of accuracy, including reviewing timesheets, deductions, and time off accruals.
- Ensure payroll compliance and maintain accurate employee records.
- Limited certified payroll reporting as needed.

# Senior Pastor Administrative Assistant / Office Manager

Peninsula Covenant Church

[Redwood City, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Redwood-City%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/1164697728045589011?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7505&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7148569222480276100&crId=US_0US_0)

## Senior Pastor Administrative Assistant / Office Manager

Peninsula Covenant Church is a growing, dynamic, community-focused church in Redwood City, CA. The beautiful 16-acre campus serves as host to our worship gatherings, children and adult ministries, community center (including swim and fitness activities), preschool, after-school care, and summer programs and supports numerous partner ministries. Healthy and successful team members are those who Seek Jesus First, are Humble, Stay Hungry, Extend Grace, and Prioritize Team. We actively support a culture of collaboration, and kindness across our PCC teams. Join us in our vision, as we exist to know Jesus deeply, follow Him faithfully, and guide the next generation to do the same. Come experience what the community of PCC is all about!

To empower generations to passionately follow Jesus one person at a time.

The Senior Pastor Administrative Assistant / Office Manager provides high-level administrative and organizational support to the Senior Pastor while helping ensure the smooth and effective operation of the church office. This position serves as a trusted administrative partner to the Senior Pastor, coordinating schedules, communications, meetings, projects, and confidential matters with discretion, professionalism, and sound judgment. In addition to supporting the Senior Pastor, this role serves as the church office manager, primary coordinator for large church-wide events, and provides administrative support for key church functions, including database management. The position also assists the Executive Pastor with fundraising and development activities and other special events, and is frequently called upon to navigate complicated administrative challenges that require initiative, problem-solving, and follow-through. This position requires an individual who is deeply committed to the mission of Peninsula Covenant Church, actively participates in the life of the church, demonstrates spiritual maturity, and brings a servant-hearted approach to working with pastors, staff, volunteers, congregants, and community partners.

The Senior Pastor Administrative Assistant / Office Manager reports to the Senior Pastor. This position works closely with the Executive Pastor, other senior directors and pastors across PCC ministries. This position interacts with the Leadership Team and the general church congregation and builds relationships with vendors, community groups, and external organizations to strengthen and expand the impact of PCC's ministry work.

### Summary of Key Responsibilities

Senior Pastor Support

- Provide comprehensive administrative support to the Senior Pastor as a trusted, highly organized administrative partner.
- Manage and coordinate the Senior Pastor's calendar, appointments, meetings, speaking engagements, and other commitments.
- Prepare agendas, meeting materials, correspondence, presentations, and other documents as needed.
- Coordinate travel arrangements, registrations, hospitality, and logistical details for ministry-related activities.
- Track assignments, commitments, follow-up items, and deadlines to help ensure timely completion.
- Screen, prioritize, and respond to routine communications on behalf of the Senior Pastor when appropriate.
- Assist with communication and coordination between the Senior Pastor, staff, leadership teams, volunteers, members, and outside organizations.
- Handle sensitive and confidential information with a high degree of discretion and professionalism.
- Anticipate needs and proactively address administrative matters before they become problems.
- Help the Senior Pastor remain focused on ministry priorities by managing appropriate administrative details and follow-up.
- Maintain relationships with and provide support to key partners such as PCC's leadership team, nominating committee, and both our regional and national parent organizations.

Church-Wide Event Coordination

- Serve as the primary administrative coordinator and/or event coordinator for major church-wide events and activities, including but not limited to:
- Church-wide celebrations and special services
- Congregational meetings
- Leadership events
- Special events

- Establish timelines, schedules, and task lists.
- Coordinate communication among pastors, ministry leaders, staff, volunteers, vendors, and other participants.
- Reserve facilities and coordinate room setups, equipment, supplies, catering, and other logistical needs.
- Maintain event budgets and track expenses as assigned.
- Coordinate event details across multiple departments.
- Identify potential logistical challenges and develop solutions.
- Ensure appropriate follow-up and documentation after events.
- Serve as the central administrative point of contact for assigned large-scale events.

Executive Pastor & Fundraising Support

- Provide administrative assistance to the Executive Pastor as assigned.
- Assist with fundraising and development activities, including campaign-related administrative tasks.
- Coordinate meetings, communications, schedules, materials, and follow-up associated with fundraising initiatives.
- Maintain appropriate donor records and tracking systems.
- Assist with donor-related events and communications
- Handle confidential financial and donor information with appropriate discretion.

Office Management & Special Projects

- Oversee the Church office, including scheduling, ordering supplies, overseeing volunteers, answering questions, and answering the phone.
- Takes ownership of complicated administrative issues and sees them through to resolution.
- Research options, gather information, identify solutions, and make appropriate recommendations.
- Spearhead effective database management across all ministries using Planning Center Online (PCO), including peer support and training.
- Support and train all ministry administrators to ensure cohesion and unified processes across ministries
- Coordinate across multiple departments to resolve problems.
- Develop systems, procedures, and tools that improve organizational effectiveness.
- Manage special projects assigned by the Senior Pastor or Executive Pastor.
- Exercise sound judgment regarding when to resolve an issue independently and when to seek direction.
- Follow through consistently until projects and problems are completed or resolved.

Spiritual & Ministry Responsibilities

- Work in collaboration with the Spiritual Formation staff to coordinate the administrative and logistical details associated with memorial services, weddings, and other special services.
- Maintain appropriate boundaries and confidentiality when working with sensitive pastoral, personnel, financial, or congregational information.
- Other duties as they pertain to an aide in supporting the Ministry's principal objective.

### Profile Skills and Core Competencies

The successful candidate will demonstrate:

- **Spiritual Maturity** A deep, personal relationship with Jesus and a commitment to living a biblically faithful life and alignment with PCC's Statement of Faith and Staff Values.
- **Administrative Excellence** Highly organized, detail-oriented, dependable, and able to create systems that work.
- **Discretion & Trustworthiness** Handles confidential information with wisdom, maturity, and integrity.
- **Relationship Building** Builds positive working relationships with pastors, staff, volunteers, members, vendors, and community partners.
- **Problem Solving** Comfortable navigating complicated situations and finding practical solutions.
- **Flexibility** Able to shift priorities and respond effectively when unexpected needs arise.
- **Servant Leadership** Approaches administrative work as ministry and seeks to make others more effective.
- **Communication** Communicates clearly, warmly, professionally, and appropriately with different audiences.
- **Anticipation & Initiative** Sees what needs to be done and takes action without always being asked.

### Qualifications Required

- Active and growing Christian faith.
- Regular participation in the life and worship of a local church, with a willingness to actively participate in Peninsula Covenant Church.
- Minimum of 35 years of progressively responsible administrative, executive assistant, office management, church administration, or related experience.
- Exceptional organizational and time-management skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and follow-through.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Workspace.
- Ability to learn and effectively use church database and administrative systems.
- Previous experience working in a church or ministry environment. (preferred)
- Experience with fundraising, donor relations, or capital campaigns. (preferred)
- Experience coordinating events for 50-500 people (preferred)

### Physical Requirements

# Senior Bookkeeper (Carmel)

Location:Castleton, INCompany:Nelson & Frankenberger, LLC

## Description:

Nelson & Frankenberger is seeking an experienced, highly dependable **Senior Bookkeeper** to oversee the day-to-day financial operations of both the law firm and its affiliated title company, RTS Title.

This critical position requires exceptional accuracy, sound judgment, discretion, and a strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls. The Senior Bookkeeper serves as a trusted financial resource responsible for maintaining accurate records, managing billing and payment activity, processing reconciliations, supporting payroll-related administration, and overseeing financial transactions associated with legal and title operations.

This role works with client funds, trust accounts, title transactions, payroll-related records, and other regulated financial activities. As such, exceptional attention to detail, professional integrity, and adherence to established accounting procedures are essential.

The ideal candidate will bring substantial bookkeeping or accounting experience, preferably within a law firm, title company, accounting firm, financial services organization, or other professional-services environment.

**Why This Role Matters**

The Senior Bookkeeper plays a vital role in protecting the financial integrity of both the law firm and title company. This position manages financial processes requiring precision, confidentiality, regulatory compliance, and strong internal controls.

We are seeking a professional who takes ownership of their work, understands the importance of accuracy in financial reporting and transaction management, and takes pride in maintaining well-organized and compliant financial operations.

**Essential Responsibilities**

**Core Financial Operations (Applicable to Both Nelson & Frankenberger and RTS Title)**

- Maintain accurate financial records and prepare weekly and monthly financial reports.
- Process accounts payable and accounts receivable, including invoice entry, payment processing, collections support, and vendor payment administration.
- Process checks, deposits, incoming payments, wire transfers, and account transfers while maintaining appropriate financial controls.
- Perform monthly bank account reconciliations and resolve discrepancies promptly.
- Maintain check stock, banking supplies, and related financial records.
- Support payroll administration, compensation reporting, employee benefit tracking, insurance records, and SIMPLE IRA recordkeeping.
- Prepare reimbursement payments and other approved disbursements.
- Ensure compliance with established accounting procedures, internal controls, and documentation requirements.
- Assist with financial audits, reporting requests, and other accounting-related projects as needed.
- Serve as a backup resource for designated HR, office management, and financial administrative functions.

**Nelson & Frankenberger (Law Firm) Responsibilities**

- Enter and post attorney and staff time.
- Prepare attorney prebills, process approved billing adjustments, and generate monthly client invoices.
- Prepare specialized client invoices and apply approved discounts when authorized.
- Submit invoices through Legal Tracker and other client billing platforms.
- Monitor accounts receivable and provide attorneys with information regarding outstanding client balances.
- Manage monthly lease payments and firm-specific financial obligations.
- Support partner compensation, quarterly distributions, and bonus-related financial processes.

**RTS Title Company Responsibilities**

- Perform daily and monthly IOLTA/trust account reconciliations.
- Process title-related checks, incoming and outgoing wire transfers, and transaction disbursements.
- Verify SoftPro orders balance prior to disbursement and confirm all closing requirements have been satisfied.
- Track transactions requiring disbursement and maintain daily disbursement reports.
- Process and track commission payments.
- Enter payroll information into Perfect Practice.
- Manage title company operating and trust account activity, including canceled-order transactions.
- Ensure compliance with trust accounting requirements, title regulations, and client-fund handling procedures.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
- Five (5) or more years of bookkeeping, accounting, or comparable financial operations experience.
- Demonstrated experience with:
- Bank reconciliations
- Accounts payable
- Accounts receivable
- Billing and invoicing
- Financial reporting
- General bookkeeping functions
- Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other business software applications.
- Ability to maintain accurate records and follow established accounting procedures and internal controls.
- High level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential financial, employee, client, and partner information.

**Preferred**

- CPA designation preferred but not required.
- Experience within a law firm, title company, accounting firm, financial services organization, or similarly regulated environment.
- Experience with trust accounts, escrow accounts, IOLTA accounts, client funds, or other regulated financial accounts.
- Experience processing wire transfers and transaction-based financial activities.
- Experience with legal, accounting, title, or practice-management software.
- Experience with SoftPro, Perfect Practice, Legal Tracker, or comparable systems.

**Knowledge, Skills & Attributes**

The successful candidate will be:

- Exceptionally detail-oriented with a strong commitment to accuracy.
- Highly organized and capable of managing multiple recurring deadlines.
- Dependable and consistent in following established procedures.
- Comfortable taking ownership of critical financial processes.
- Able to identify discrepancies and resolve issues proactively.
- Skilled at reconciling information across multiple systems.
- Trustworthy and discreet when handling sensitive information.
- Professional and composed when communicating with attorneys, staff, clients, vendors, financial institutions, and outside partners.
- Capable of exercising sound judgment and recognizing when additional review or approval is necessary.
- Proactive in maintaining organized documentation and strong financial controls.
- Comfortable working independently while communicating effectively regarding questions or concerns.

**Benefits**

Nelson & Frankenberger offers a competitive benefits package, including:

- Competitive compensation
- Paid Time Off
- Health, dental, life, and disability insurance
- SIMPLE IRA with employer match

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Nelson & Frankenberger is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, genetic information, national origin, race, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

**Recruiting Agencies:** Please do not contact us regarding this position. Unsolicited resumes submitted by staffing agencies will not be accepted.

**Disclaimer:** This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of duties, responsibilities, or qualifications. Duties and responsibilities may be modified at any time to meet the needs of the firm.

# Senior Administrative Assistant

Location:Union City, CACompany:Southland Industries

## Description:

\*\*Position Summary\*\* The Senior Administrative Assistant serves as a trusted partner to the Division Lead of Southland Industries' Northern California Division, providing high-level administrative, organizational, and operational support that enables effective leadership of the business. This role is responsible for managing a wide range of confidential and business-critical activities, including executive calendar management, meeting and event coordination, travel arrangements, correspondence, presentations, reports, and expense administration. As a key member of the division team, the Senior Administrative Assistant acts as a central point of coordination across departments, helping ensure seamless communication, efficient operations, and alignment with division priorities. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. This individual demonstrates exceptional professionalism, discretion, and customer service while building strong relationships with leaders, employees, clients, and external partners. In addition to supporting day-to-day administrative functions, the Senior Administrative Assistant may coordinate special projects, prepare executive-level materials, maintain records and documentation, and contribute to initiatives that support the continued growth and success of Southland's Northern California Division. \*\*Position Details\*\* + Provides a variety of clerical and administrative duties to support a department and/or senior-level managers. Duties generally include: + Document editing, proofing, formatting, and production. + Drafting correspondence, which may be sensitive and confidential in nature. + Data input/maintenance and paper/electronic document filing/archiving. + Opening, sorting, and distributing mail. + Receiving/relaying telephone messages from internal and external sources. Screening telephone + calls and visitors. Analyzing information requests and determining responses. + Preparing routine and non-routine reports and presentation materials, including graphs and charts. + Scheduling and coordinating meetings, events and travel arrangements; may negotiate prices for meeting venues and vendor services. + Ordering and delivering supplies. + Expense report preparation, audit, and submission. + May assist and coordinate small projects as needed \*\*Qualifications\*\* + High School Diploma or equivalent is required. + Associate degree or bachelor's degree preferred but not required. + Experience supporting executive-level leaders, business unit leaders, or senior management teams in a fast-paced corporate environment preferred + Proven ability to build positive working relationships across all levels of an organization and interact professionally with customers, vendors, and executive leadership. + Self-starter with the ability to work independently, anticipate needs, and proactively resolve issues. + Experience coordinating executive meetings, travel, events, and cross-functional projects. + 4 years of administrative support experience + Strong verbal and written communication skills: + Ability to communicate with all organizational levels + Experience within construction, engineering, manufacturing, professional services, or other project-based industries preferred. + Excellent customer service skills + Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint. + Ability to operate and troubleshoot office equipment + Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills with the ability to adapt to changing business priorities. + Project coordination skills + Ability to properly manage sensitive and confidential materials \*\*Benefits\*\* As a 100% employee-owned company, we offer a comprehensive benefits package for you and your family: + 401(k) plan with \*\*50% company match (no cap)\*\* and immediate 100% vesting + Medical, dental, and vision insurance \*\*(100% paid for employee)\*\* + Annual bonus program based upon performance, achievement, and company profitability + Term life, AD&D insurance, and voluntary life insurance + Disability income protection insurance + Pre-tax flexible spending plans (health and dependent care) + \*\*Paid parental leave\*\* + Paid holidays, vacation, and personal time + Training/professional development opportunities and company-paid memberships for professional associations and licenses + Wellness benefits \*\*About Southland Industries\*\* As one of the nation's largest MEP companies, Southland Industries is built on the foundation of great people. Since 1949, we have put our people first, enabling growth, professional achievement, and innovation. If you want to join a fast-paced environment where you're engaged, challenged, and valued, apply now to join our dynamic team. To learn more about careers at Southland, explore our career opportunities (https://southlandind.foleon.com/experienced-professionals/brochure/) , follow us on social media (https://www.linkedin.com/company/22132/?trk=tyah) , and check out our website (https://southlandind.com/) . Southland Industries and all its subsidiaries are an \*\*Equal Opportunity Employer\*\* and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We are committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing our employees with a safe work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Southland Industries are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, gender, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, marital status, family care or medical leave status, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Southland Industries will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. \*\*Pay:\*\* Final pay is determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with market data. For California this ranges from $67,105.00- $79,305.00 plus annual incentive, benefits, and retirement program as outlined above. \*\*Contingent Employment:\*\* All employment offers are contingent upon successful drug tests, background checks, and professional reference checks. Roles that include driving as an essential job duty will be required to have a successful Motor Vehicle Record check (MVR). We are not able to offer sponsorship of employment at this time. \*\*External Agency Announcement\*\* : Its Southland Industries' policy not to accept candidate submissions from recruiting agencies without an active and authorized work order. ##### Administrative Coordinator

The Judicial Council of California is accepting applications for the position of Administrative Coordinator with the Center for Judicial Education and Resources.

The Administrative Coordinator position schedules and performs project management and logistical tasks required to deliver education programs and products for judges, court managers and court personnel. Staff work directly in support of faculty and collaborate with attorneys and education developers responsible for the training and recruitment of faculty and creation of course content. They coordinate the work performed by staff providing A/V Support Services, Distance Education/Media Production, meeting planning and contracting, course and program registration, printing, and mailing, and provide program management for live programs, supporting faculty and working with local site personnel. Staff work independently on more than one assigned program or product at a time and are responsible for coordinating the implementation of a variety of delivery mechanisms including but not limited to the following: in-person conferences, statewide institutes, regional education courses, local training courses, webinars, online videos, podcasts, and videoconferences.

This position is responsible for providing the full range of administrative coordination and project management duties required to deliver multiple education programs currently planned and approved by the Judicial Council as part of the Judicial Branch Education Plans. In order to ensure the work of the office is completed within budget and on time, assignments will be flexibly rotated, therefore, this position is expected to be capable of performing all coordinator duties.

The Judicial Council The Judicial Council of California is the policy setting body for the state court system and has constitutionally conferred statewide rule-making authority. This authority includes developing, advocating for, and allocating the judicial branch budget. A majority of Council members are California state justices and judges; however, the Council also includes lawyers, legislators, and court administrators.

By enhancing its role as a leadership, knowledge, and service resource for the judicial branch, the Judicial Council's staff organization seeks to continue to evolve as one of California's most dynamic public service entities, focused on improving access to justice for all Californians by innovating and responding to the changing needs of the courts and the public. As a government body charged with improving the statewide administration of justice, the Judicial Council has multiple offices with diverse responsibilities relating to court policy and operations. As employees of the council, every member of staff should view and approach their work as one Judicial Council with a public service mission that is greater than the sum of its parts.

The Judicial Council strives for work-life balance, including substantial vacation and holiday time. In addition, we offer an excellent benefits package, including pension, medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending, up to $130 per month reimbursement for qualifying commuting costs, student loan forgiveness as part of Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), and retirement savings plans. The San Francisco office is only a 7-minute walk from the downtown Civic Center BART station. In Sacramento, the office is located minutes from downtown, just north of Discovery Park.

The Judicial Council offers hybrid work arrangements for many positions. The successful candidate will be expected to work in person at the Judicial Council's San Francisco or Sacramento office at least two days per week, based on their office leader's direction, and reside in the areas surrounding these locations. - Manage materials preparation and distribution.
- Obtain and maintain course materials from faculty.
- Coordinate program publicity.
- Invoice processing.

Associate's degree, preferably in area(s) of assignment, and one (1) year of administrative support experience, including some experience in area(s) of assignment (such as accounting, writing/editing, database/spreadsheets, direct support to upper management, etc.). Additional directly related experience and/or education may be substituted on a year-for-year basis.

OR

One (1) year as an Administrative Specialist, Facilities Specialist, or Fiscal Services Specialist with the Judicial Council of California or one year of experience performing the duties of a class comparable in the level of responsibility to that of an Administrative Specialist, Facilities Specialist, or Fiscal Services Specialist in a California superior court or California state-level government entity.

### Job Description

Job Description

Our client, a respected and growing **skilled nursing facility (SNF)** operator across the Western United States, is seeking an experienced **Business Office Manager (BOM)** to lead the financial and administrative operations of their skilled nursing facilities within post-acute care.

This is a role for someone who takes ownership. You'll walk into an established, well-functioning business office and be trusted to lead it with precision, integrity, and heart.

**What You'll Be Doing**

- Oversee the full revenue cycle - from admission contracts through final collection - across Medicare, Medicaid, Managed Care, and private pay
- Lead and develop the business office team, providing day-to-day guidance, training, and performance oversight
- Prepare and present key financial reports to facility administration and the corporate office
- Serve as the primary point of contact for residents and families regarding billing, financial inquiries, and payment arrangements — handling every conversation with professionalism and empathy
- Ensure all business office operations remain in strict compliance with federal, state, and company regulations; support financial audits as needed
- Manage or supervise payroll processing and accounts payable functions with accuracy and timeliness
- Leverage facility software systems (PointClickCare, Matrix) and identify ongoing opportunities to improve processes and financial performance

**What You'll Bring**

- 2+ years of experience as a Business Office Manager in a Skilled Nursing Facility, LTACH, or comparable healthcare environment
- Expert knowledge of the SNF revenue cycle, including Medicare, Medicaid, Managed Care, and third-party billing
- Proficiency with healthcare financial software — PointClickCare experience is a strong plus
- A track record of leading administrative teams with confidence and clarity
- Sharp analytical and organizational skills with strong attention to detail
- The highest level of discretion when handling confidential resident and financial information
- Outstanding communication and customer service skills across all stakeholder levels — residents, families, and corporate partners alike

**Why This Role**

- Walk into stability - established systems, a strong team, and a well-run operation from day one
- Real autonomy - you'll have the authority to run your department and the support of a collaborative leadership team
- Strategic seat at the table - your work directly impacts the financial health of the facility

SB 848 Child Safety & Employment Disclosure Requirement
Effective January 1, 2026, in accordance with California Senate Bill 848 (School Employee Misconduct/Child Abuse Prevention Act), applicants for employment with San José Unified are subject to enhanced child safety, training, and employment disclosure requirements.

Under SB 848, schools are required to strengthen background vetting procedures and obtain employment history information related to allegations of egregious misconduct involving students. Former employers may be contacted to release records regarding substantiated findings of misconduct as permitted by law. Failure to provide complete and accurate information regarding prior educational employment or relevant misconduct findings may result in disqualification from the hiring process or withdrawal of an offer of employment.

SB 848 also expands mandated reporter requirements and requires annual child abuse prevention training for employees and certain volunteers by July 1, 2026. All employees must comply with district-adopted child safety policies, including procedures for supervising and protecting students.

San José Unified is committed to maintaining a safe and supportive learning environment for all students and will review all disclosures and employment records in accordance with state law.
