## Administrative Assistant

The Judicial Council of California is accepting applications for the position of Administrative Assistant for the Branch Accounting and Procurement (BAP) office.

Under the direct supervision of the Branch Accounting and Procurement Deputy Director, the Administrative Assistant is the first point of contact for JCC offices located in the 2850 Gateway Oaks building in Sacramento. This position is responsible for providing reception to internal agency staff, other governmental offices, and the trial courts. The Administrative Assistant also provides staff support and serves as a backup for administrative services.

The Judicial Council of California is the policymaking body for the state court system and has constitutionally conferred statewide rule-making authority. This authority includes developing, advocating for, and allocating the judicial branch budget. A majority of Council members are California state justices and judges; however, the Council also includes lawyers, legislators, and court administrators.

By enhancing its role as a leadership, knowledge, and service resource for the judicial branch, the Judicial Council's staff organization seeks to continue to evolve as one of California's most dynamic public service entities, focused on improving access to justice for all Californians by innovating and responding to the changing needs of the courts and the public. As a government body charged with improving the statewide administration of justice, the Judicial Council has multiple offices with diverse responsibilities relating to court policy and operations. As employees of the council, every member of staff should view and approach their work as one Judicial Council with a public service mission that is greater than the sum of its parts.

The Judicial Council strives for work life balance and includes substantial vacation and holiday time. In addition, we offer an excellent benefits package including pension, medical, dental and vision coverage, flexible spending, up to $130 per month reimbursement for qualifying commuting costs, student loan forgiveness as part of Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF), and retirement savings plans. In Sacramento, the office is minutes from downtown, just north of Discovery Park.

The Judicial Council offers hybrid work arrangements for many positions. The successful candidate will be expected to work in person at the Judicial Council's Sacramento office at least two days per week, based on their office leader's direction, and reside in the areas surrounding this location. To be eligible for Judicial Council employment and participation in the Judicial Council's Hybrid Work Program, a prospective or current employee's primary residence/remote work location must be in the State of California and within a 150-mile driving radius of their assigned reporting location.

### Responsibilities

Reception Services

- Answers incoming calls, determines the purpose of the call, and directs callers to the appropriate staff; as back-up, answers all TCAS unit general hot lines
- Determines the purpose of visits and directs visitors to the proper staff
- Provides factual information regarding the Judicial Council and the various services provided by the multiple units and offices located in Sacramento

Staff Support Services

- Serves as back-up to the Executive Secretary and administrative staff
- Coordinates meetings and conference room availability
- Tracks special equipment reserved by staff

Mailroom Services

- Prepares out-going mail for statewide distribution in large volumes, primarily on behalf of the courts
- Tracks, sorts, and distributes incoming mail for Sacramento offices in multiple locations
- Prepares and tracks outgoing expedited mail (Federal Express)

Invoice and Purchase Requisition Processing

- Tracks incoming invoices to ensure they are processed timely
- Applies coding strip and signature boxes to invoices and routes them for signature
- Prepares recurring purchase requisitions for office supplies and equipment

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE High school diploma, GED, or equivalent, and one (1) year of administrative/clerical experience. Some positions may require proficiency on certain office machines. Additional directly related experience and/or education may be substituted on a year-for-year basis.

LICENSING AND CERTIFICATIONS- Required for driving assignment: California Commercial Driver's License with Passenger Endorsements.

**Desirable Qualifications** Excellent customer service and communication skills Proficiency in Microsoft Office products Proficiency in use of standard office machinery (e.g., photocopier, shredder, facsimile, etc.)

# Veterinary Receptionist (Part-time)

$20 - $22 per hour

Companion Pet Services Inc

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-2213543611753221312?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-1476812536307745539&crId=US_0US_0)

Why Join Our Team
La Jolla Veterinary Hospital is a thriving veterinary practice located in the heart of La Jolla Village, one of San Diego's most picturesque and walkable neighborhoods. Just three blocks from the beach, our hospital offers the perfect blend of professional growth and coastal lifestyle in a vibrant, seaside setting.

Our newly renovated space features modern technology including IDEXX lab equipment, digital radiography, and a dedicated surgical suite. As a general practice that also accepts walk-ins and urgent care, we provide diverse cases and skill-building opportunities while maintaining our commitment to excellent medical care with genuine compassion at the heart of everything we do.

What Sets Us Apart

Prime Location: Just three blocks from the beach in walkable La Jolla Village

Diverse Medicine: General practice that also handles walk-ins and urgent care

Modern Facility: Newly renovated space with state-of-the-art equipment

Innovation Hub: Surrounded by science, clinical research, and marine biology industries

Community Connection: Tight-knit, community-driven team in a bike and pedestrian-friendly area

Located in beautiful La Jolla, take beach strolls on your lunch break and enjoy ocean views during your commute. Experience professional fulfillment in a setting that values your personal wellness and offers the perfect balance of challenging medicine and seaside serenity.

About This Role
As a part-time Client Care Representative, you'll be the warm, welcoming face of our veterinary practice! In this vital front-line position, you'll create positive first impressions with our clients and set the tone for their entire experience with us.

You’ll be the compassionate bridge between our clients and their beloved pets' care, guiding pet parents through appointments, answering questions, and ensuring smooth operations at our reception area. This role combines your people skills, organizational abilities, and genuine love for animals to help us deliver exceptional veterinary care.

\*Saturday shifts required\*

What Success Looks Like

Creating Exceptional First Impressions: You'll warmly greet clients and their pets, making them feel welcome and valued from the moment they contact our practice.

Communication Excellence: You'll skillfully manage multi-line phone systems, gather and document important information accurately, and convey pet care instructions clearly and compassionately.

Appointment Wizard: You'll masterfully schedule, confirm, and manage appointments while efficiently handling check-ins and check-outs with proper documentation.

Team Coordination: You'll promptly alert appropriate departments when patients arrive, distribute daily schedules, and ensure patient files are properly prepared and updated.

Professional Environment: You'll maintain an inviting, clean, and organized reception area that helps create a positive experience for clients and their pets.

What Makes You a Great Fit

Providing a welcoming and professional first impression by greeting every client with efficiency and warmth

Ability to multi-task and attend to multi-line phone systems and veterinary programs

Proficient in handling high volume, high stress cases while maintaining professionalism

Efficiently optimize clinic workflow through strategic appointment scheduling and proactive confirmation calls

Maintaining any required documents or medical records

Upholding rigorous hospital standards for cleanliness and organization

Accurately handle deposits and financial transactions from clients

Accurately educate clients on veterinary services and best practices for animal care

Education & Experience

High School Diploma/GED or equivalent required

1 year of experience preferred

Experience in the veterinary field, familiarity with terminology and protocols

Manage cash handling and financial transactions

How We’ll Support You

Competitive Pay: $20.00 - $22.00 per hour, commensurate with experience

Comprehensive Benefits: 401k with company match

Growth Opportunities: Continuing education and professional development support

Work-Life Balance: PTO and mental health assistance

Perks: Employee discounts on services, a scrub allowance, and a referral program

A Welcoming Team: We’re a hard-working and collaborative team where your voice matters!

EEO Statement
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

ARENA SNK, Inc

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5451764222483893165?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=114&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-4119702728092317152&crId=US_0US_0)

Job Description
About Us

The Arena is an independent studio creating global franchises inspired by the worlds of gaming, anime, and event action. With a world-class executive team, robust financing, and deep access to top-tier IP, it is uniquely equipped to build a modern fandom ecosystem.

The Arena is a space for and by fans. It engages and expands committed fanbases through an always-on model of offerings, including premium film and television, robust social media communities and content, experiential events, and consumer goods. The Arena is committed to artistic ambition and excellence across its slate of blockbuster films and event series.

Producing and financing projects made alongside renowned filmmakers and breakout talents, it aims to blend prestige-level quality with franchise scale, doing justice to some of the world's most beloved properties and their fans.

The Role

We are looking for an Executive Assistant with a passion for marketing and brand to work directly with the President of Marketing & Brand.

This role sits at the center of the President’s day-to-day operations. You’ll help manage the flow of information, priorities, and communication across internal teams and external partners. The right person is highly organized, pro-active, and able to keep multiple moving pieces aligned without losing sight of the bigger picture.

You’ll own travel arrangement and expense management the same way as calendar management and scheduling, help prepare for and follow up on meetings, capture key notes and decisions, and make sure conversations translate into clear next steps. You'll be curious about the marketing side of the organization — helping coordinate decks and documents, keeping the wider marketing team organized where needed.

We are looking for someone with 1–2 years of professional experience, strong organizational instincts, and an interest and base understanding of how creative and marketing teams operate within entertainment or media.

You should be someone who not only keeps things running smoothly, but who is a fan and with a passion for today's pop culture and is deeply immersed in anime, gaming, and modern action storytelling — as well as the communities that surround them.

Location This role is based out of our Los Angeles, CA office and is fully in-person.

What You’ll Do

Manage the President of Marketing & Brand’s calendar, scheduling, and meeting logistics

Prepare meeting materials and capture notes, decisions, and follow-ups

Track action items and ensure conversations translate into execution

Coordinate marketing decks, documents, and campaign materials

Arrange travel, manage expenses and other logistics.

Support internal marketing processes and team coordination

Assist with research and preparation related to marketing initiatives and partnerships

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role
The best candidates for this role don’t just wait for instructions — they anticipate what’s needed and help keep things moving. You should be comfortable taking ownership of tasks, identifying gaps before they become problems, and helping bring clarity and structure to fast-moving conversations and ideas.

This role works best for someone who enjoys being close to the operational side of a fast-moving Entertainment company and who is motivated by helping teams execute at a high level.

This Role Is a Great Fit If…

You are highly organized and naturally keep track of moving pieces without being asked

You enjoy bringing clarity and structure to fast-moving conversations and projects

You are proactive and comfortable anticipating needs rather than waiting for instructions

You are deeply interested in modern pop culture, particularly anime, gaming, and action storytelling

You want exposure to how marketing, brand, and franchise strategy operate inside a growing studio

Qualifications
Qualifications

1–2 years of professional experience in a marketing, assistant, or coordinator role

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Media Studies, or a related field preferred — or equivalent professional experience

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Arena SNK does not provide visa sponsorship.

**What we offer:**
We believe the people who help build something great should be taken care of — fully.

Competitive Salary

Medical, Dental & Vision: 100% employer-paid cove

Location: Sacramento, CA 95815 Job Type: Full-Time, In-Office Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Salary: $60,000–$75,000 per year, depending on experience

About the Position

We are seeking an experienced Construction Bookkeeper to join our team in Sacramento. This is a full-time, in-office position for someone who is organized, detail-oriented, dependable, and experienced with the accounting needs of a construction company.

The ideal candidate will have at least 3–4 years of hands-on QuickBooks experience along with construction accounting/bookkeeping experience. We are looking for someone who understands the unique financial processes involved in the construction industry and can confidently manage day-to-day bookkeeping responsibilities with accuracy.

Responsibilities

Manage day-to-day bookkeeping and accounting transactions

Maintain accurate records in QuickBooks

Process accounts payable and accounts receivable

Enter and reconcile bank and credit card transactions

Prepare and send customer invoices

Track incoming payments and outstanding balances

Maintain vendor accounts and process vendor invoices

Assist with payroll-related accounting and recordkeeping

Perform bank and account reconciliations

Track expenses by project/job

Maintain accurate job costing records

Track labor, materials, subcontractor costs, and other project-related expenses

Assist with construction project billing and financial reporting

Maintain organized documentation for vendors, subcontractors, customers, and projects

Prepare reports for management as requested

Assist with month-end accounting and financial reconciliation

Work closely with management to ensure financial records are accurate and up to date

Required Qualifications

3–4+ years of QuickBooks experience

3–4+ years of construction accounting and/or construction bookkeeping experience

Strong understanding of accounts payable and accounts receivable

Experience with job costing and project-based accounting

Experience reconciling bank and credit card accounts

Strong attention to detail and accuracy

Excellent organizational and time-management skills

Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines

Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of bookkeeping responsibilities

Strong communication skills

Proficient with Microsoft Excel and general office software

Construction accounting/bookkeeping experience is required for this position.

Schedule

Monday through Friday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM

This is an in-office position located in Sacramento, CA 95815. Remote work is not available for this role.

Compensation

$60,000–$75,000 per year, based on relevant construction bookkeeping/accounting experience and qualifications.

If you have strong QuickBooks skills and hands-on experience managing bookkeeping or accounting for a construction company, we encourage you to apply.

To apply, please submit your resume highlighting your QuickBooks and construction accounting experience.

We are seeking a highly experienced QuickBooks Enterprise/Desktop user to take ownership of day-to-day accounting operations and order processing in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

Accounting & QuickBooks

Daily use of QuickBooks Enterprise/Desktop

Process Sales Orders, Invoices, Purchase Orders, Item Receipts, and RMAs

Track open Sales Orders, POs, and RMAs

Ensure order flow and fulfillment progress

Process payments and coordinate with internal teams

**Administrative Support:**

Maintain organized records (digital and physical)

Assist with payroll, HR, and office operations

Fast-paced, high-volume office environment. This is a fragrance-free workplace to support the health and comfort of all employees.

Requirements

Strong QuickBooks Enterprise/Desktop experience

Accounting or bookkeeping background

High attention to detail

Ability to manage high volume workload

Understanding of financial statements

Proficiency in Office 365

# Accounting Clerk

VPE Thermal LLC

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5062370601787420518?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-186582305937577875&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

- Manage all aspects of the full accounting cycle: A/P, A/R, payroll, bank reconciliations, journal entries, and general ledger.
- Maintain and update the chart of accounts; ensure accurate classification and coding of all transactions.
- Process vendor invoices and match with purchase orders and receipts.
- Generate and issue customer invoices based on sales orders, delivery notes, or project milestones.
- Ensure accuracy of billing details including pricing, taxes, shipping, and payment terms.
- Coordinate with engineers to confirm job completion or delivery for invoicing.
- Monitor aging reports and follow up on overdue receivables.
- Collect, review, and verify receipts and supporting documentation for all company credit card transactions.
- Ensure transactions are properly coded to the correct general ledger accounts, jobs/projects, and departments.
- Communicate with cardholders to resolve missing receipts, incorrect coding, or policy violations.
- Track raw material and perform monthly inventory reconciliation.
- Prepare and post adjusting journal entries.
- Reconcile balance sheet accounts and analyze P&L accounts.
- Assist with biweekly payroll processing and manage timesheets.
- Process employee expense reports.
- Support external audits and provide necessary documentation.
- Provide backup support for other accounting team members during vacations, absences, or peak periods.
- Take on additional tasks as needed to support business continuity.

\\nCompany Description

VPE Thermal, a growth world leader in microchannel heat exchanger design and manufacturing serves many global industries including power generation, chemical processing, oil/gas, nuclear and renewable energy. We foster a strong culture of R&D, design, manufacturing and analysis to meet tomorrow’s heat exchanger challenges.

$24 - $30 per hour

PrideStaff

### Job Description

Job Description

Job: Payroll & Accounts Payable Specialist

Pay: $24 - $30/hr D.O.E.

Location: Sacramento, CA

Schedule: Full Time M - F  Business Hours!

Excellent Benefits Include: Medical, Dental, Vision, & More...

Payroll & Accounts Payable Specialist Job Description:

PrideStaff Financial is working with a local manufacturing company who is seeking a Payroll & Accounts Payable Specialist.  The Payroll & Accounts Payable Specialist is responsible for ensuring the accurate, timely, and compliant execution of all Payroll and Accounts Payable functions. The ideal Payroll & Accounts Payable Specialist brings exceptional analytical capabilities and accurate attention to detail, alongside the professionalism required to manage sensitive financial information with total confidentiality.  The Payroll & Accounts Payable Specialist position reports directly to the Accounting Manager.

Payroll & Accounts Payable Specialist Duties & Responsibilities:

- Process Multi-State Weekly/Bi-Weekly Payroll For Hourly, Salaried, & Contracted Staff
- Validate Timekeeping Data, Including Hours Worked, Overtime, PTO, & Wage Adjustments
- Maintain Employee Records Ensuring Full Compliance With Federal, State, & Local Regulations
- Manage Payroll lifecycle Changes, Covering New Hires, Terminations, Compensation Adjustments, & Benefits
- Reconcile Payroll Reports, For Month/Quarter/Year-End Closing, W-2 Prep, & Internal Audits
- Resolve Employee Payroll Inquiries With Timely & Professional Support
- Code & Process Vendor Invoices in Compliance With Company Policies
- 3-Way Invoice Matching.  Purchase Orders, Receipts, & Invoices
- Manage Weekly Payment Runs Via Check, ACH, & Wire Transfers
- Maintain Vendor Records & Secure Required W-9 Documentation
- Reconcile Accounts Payables to The General Ledger
- Assist With Closing Activities, Including AP Accurals & Reporting
- Assist With Additional Business Needs as Requested

Payroll & Accounts Payable Specialist Requirements & Qualifications:

- High School Diploma or Equivalent Required
- 3+ Years of Multi-State Payroll Experience Coupled With Solid Wage & Hour Laws, & Compliance Requirements
- 3+ Years of Accounts Payable Experience
- Proficient With Payroll Systems Such as ADP, Paychex, Paylocity, UKG, & Accounting Software Such as JobBOSS
- Superb Excel Skills, Including Formulas, VLOOKUP, & Pivot Tables
- Exceptional Accuracy, Organizational Skills, & Attention to Details
- Strong Communication Skills & The Ability to Collaborate Effectively Across Departments
- Demonstrated Ability to Handle Confidential Information With Discretion
- Maintain a High Level of Integrity & a Proactive, Resourceful Approach Committed to Continuous Improvement
- Apply Strong Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills to Manage Multiple Priorities & Meet Tight Deadlines in a Fast-Paced Environment
- Work With a Team-Oriented Mindset Focused on Delivering a Strong Customer Service Experience
- Previous Experience Supporting Payroll & AP in a Multi-Entity or High Volume Environment
- Familiarity With 1099 Processing & Year-End AP Reporting
- Exposure to General Ledger Processes or Basic Accounting Principles

PrideStaff Hiring Requirements:

- Must be 18+ Years Old
- Must be Willing to Submit to a Pre-Employment Background Check
- Must be Willing to Submit to a Drug Screen
- Must be Able to Provide Proof of Eligibility to Work in The U.S.

Enhance your career with a full-time job, with a great company, competitive wages, and let PrideStaff Financial support you in your future employment endeavors. Your future starts with PrideStaff Financial!

# Project Coordinator

$105k - $160.2k

Bechtel Global Corporation

[Sacramento, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Sacramento%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5602988458982748346?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7228&pageType=7&jobAge=66&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7349977111533165910&crId=US_0US_0)

Requisition ID: 292484
Relocation Authorized: National - Family

Telework Type: Full-Time Office/Project

Work Location: Riverside, CA

Salary Range: $105,000 - $160,200 annually (Determined by function, education, experience, and qualifications of the applicant.)

San Francisco, CA Positions: A 10% salary uplift is provided on top of base salary for positions that are worked in San Jose, CA, and San Francisco, CA, which is subject to change depending on market conditions.

Project Overview
Bechtel has been providing program, project, and construction management services to the Riverside County Transportation Commission (RCTC) for 37 years. The project team supports RCTC in implementing "Measure A," the Regional Transportation Plan (RTP), Sustainable Communities Strategy (SCS), and other adopted plans and programs, ensuring compliance with state and federal requirements. The goal is to enhance mobility, improve quality of life, promote operational excellence, and foster economic vitality for Riverside County residents.

This team manages the planning, environmental clearance, design, and construction of projects on the state highway system under California Department of Transportation (Caltrans) oversight, following Caltrans' standards and procedures. They also oversee commuter and freight rail lines, working with the Federal Transit Administration (FTA), Southern California Regional Rail Authority (SCRRA), Burlington Northern Santa Fe Railroad (BNSF), and Union Pacic Railroad (UP), adhering to their respective standards. In this role, you will collaborate with a dynamic team of global industry professionals to support the project team.

Job Summary
Responsible for the organization and direction of engineering and construction personnel and activities relating to construction engineering, construction management consultants, subcontracts, and engineering liaison to the design consultants. Provide oversight to construction management consultants and ensure compliance with local, state, and federal requirements. Provides construction oversight in a wide range of construction engineering and design functions relating to highways, rail, and active transportation projects throughout Riverside County.

Major Responsibilities

Manage the procurement, selection, and oversight of construction management and design consultants for capital and toll projects - highway, rail, and active transportation.

Supervise deputy construction managers and consultant resident engineers.

Develops and recommends the construction engineering organization for approval by the RCTC Construction Manager and prepares employee requisitions.

Coordinates with engineering on constructability and design issues. Establishes a Design/Field Engineering working relationship and lines of communication with the Project Engineer including agreement on engineering deliverables. Responsible for reviewing Engineer's quantity take-offs, control, reporting, and forecasting.

Directs preparation of cost estimates for construction activities and coordinates the preparation of cost reports, forecast, and progress reports. Reviews and provides input to project controls documents on progress relating to cost and schedule.

Plans and recommends procedures to be implemented by field engineers to ensure construction operations are within requirements of engineering design and specifications.

Directs the maintenance of construction engineering records for job history. Supervises the receiving, distribution, and filing of plans and specifications.

Works with customer's resident engineering and operating personnel to coordinate construction activities.

Administers assigned subcontracts to ensure completeness and that they are up to date.

Coordinates with the Resident Engineer on contract administration and activities affecting the contract administration operation.

Administers major subcontract changes and represents the RCTC in major contractual discussions and negotiations as requested by the client.

Performs employee reviews for direct reports and assists in their development and progressive training.

Assesses needs and develops Field Engineering Training Plan for the project.

Reviews and provides input to the project staffing plan for construction engineers and associated personnel.

Ensures the implementation of project environmental control plan(s) as required.

Education and Experience Requirements

Requires bachelor's degree (or international equivalent) and 8-10 years of relevant experience or 12-14 years of relevant work experience.

A minimum of 5 years of experience working in delivery management capacity on highways and or Class 1 railway projects.

Experience with coordinating and interfacing with Class 1 railroads.

Prior experience supervising and administering subcontractors and consultants, preferred.

Required Knowledge and Skills

Licensed civil engineer in the state of California, preferred but not required.

Certified Resident Engineer by Caltrans, preferred but not required.

Total Rewards/Benefits
For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth.

At Bechtel, our employees enjoy a competitive total rewards package that includes comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, along with optional disability and supplemental insurance options, generous paid time off (160 hours annually, accrued 6.16 hours per pay period), nine paid holidays, paid parental leave, discretionary bonuses, and a well‑designed 401K plan with matching and profit‑sharing components.

### Job Description

Job Description

Job Title: Project Coordinator

Job Description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Project Coordinator to support our construction team in managing project documentation, scheduling, and communication. This role is essential in ensuring smooth project execution by assisting Project Managers and Superintendents with administrative and coordination tasks.

Key Responsibilities:

- Assist with project coordination, scheduling, and administrative tasks.
- Manage and track project documentation, including RFIs, submittals, change orders, and contracts.
- Communicate with subcontractors, suppliers, and clients to gather required documentation.
- Maintain compliance with contract requirements and company policies.
- Support permitting, insurance, and bonding processes for public and private projects.
- Monitor project budgets, purchase orders, and invoices.
- Assist with project closeout, including compiling warranties, as-builts, and final documentation.

**Requirements**

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and construction management software (Procore, Bluebeam, etc.).
- Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving ability.
- Excellent communication skills and ability to multitask.
- Understanding of construction workflows, project documentation, and contract administration.

Description

## CENTRAL OPERATIONS COORDINATOR

TEAM
Central Campus Operations, reports to: Campus Operations Supervisor

## LOCATION

STATUS: Full-time, 40 hours

## SCHEDULE:

Mon - Thurs. 9-5p\*

\*Those hours are fixed on the Front Office, with flexibility to choose the remaining hours.

Job Overview
The Central Operations Coordinator helps equip and support Sandals Church campuses and ministries through volunteer team building, coordination and administration, and hands-on operational support. The work is varied and relational, bringing people and details together, and helping our campuses thrive through behind-the-scenes work.

A significant part of this role is leading the Front Office and its volunteer team, serving Hunter Park guests and walk-ins, and field calls for all of Sandals Church. Hospitality and soul care are central to this work-creating a welcoming environment, caring for anyone who calls or walks through our doors, and helping connect people to the right campus, ministry or next step.

Key Responsibilities
Lead Front Office Team

Implement our volunteer strategy at Sandals Church, the Real Team strategy.

Foster a team culture and guest experience centered on hospitality and the love of Jesus.

Equip the team to respond to a wide variety of people and situations and questions.

Confidently support guests with complex or sensitive needs.

Ensures office space is maintained, stocked and ready.

Keep important information current, and easy to access-from campus calendars, funeral info, staff contacts, and other resources the team relies on.

Coordinate Central Operations

Coordinate Coffee and Communion ordering, distribution, accounting, and related volunteer teams.

Serve as the facilitator for Sandals Church's email: responding promptly and accurately, and responding with care when emails require confidentiality.

Support Central Campus Operations meetings by ordering meals, setup, and teardown.

Take ownership of assigned short term projects and follow them through to completion (examples: Camp projects, CCB projects, financial reporting, proof reading orders, etc.).

Campus Support

Support campus weekend services wherever ministry needs arise, which may require adjusting your home campus schedule.

Take ownership of any assigned projects and follow them through to completion, including new campus launches or large event support.

Skills & Qualifications

Lives out our vision of being real with themselves, God, and others.

Has a personal relationship with Jesus and is excited to tell others about it.

Brings strong coordination and follow-through-can keep people, details, and projects moving.

Demonstrates genuine hospitality and can teach others to serve and care for people well-regardless of their circumstances or where they are in life.

Is administratively gifted-comes with a strong foundation, can hit the ground running, and learns new systems quickly.

Communicates clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing.

Can confidently work independently when the work requires it.

Is a Sandals Church Licensed Minister or potential to be one.

Can accommodate regular physical demands, including moving deliveries and boxes of supplies.

Here’s What Matters

At the end of the day, we're looking for someone who is part people person, part admin pro, and part "I'll figure it out." Someone who can move from a spreadsheet to a soul care conversation to a last-minute campus need—and keep their head.

You're unfazed by the unexpected—including an unscheduled walk-in with a real need right when you're in the middle of ordering 100 boxes of coffee. Don't need a five-step process to know step one is just jumping in. Most of all, you care about people, care about the church, and make the people around you better because you're on the team. And you can laugh.

## COMPENSATION:

Pay Range : $20-$23 per hour

Rate determined by experience and our internal compensation structure.

##### Operations Manager

Electric Power Systems (EPS) is a NETA-accredited independent electrical testing and engineering organization specializing in electrical acceptance testing, commissioning, and maintenance for clients across Data Centers, Utility, Generation, Renewables, Transit, Industrial and Commercial Facilities throughout North America. We are committed to safety, technical expertise, and setting the standard of excellence in the power industry.

The Local Office Operations Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operational leadership, safety performance, scheduling, and financial results of a single EPS office. This role leads field technicians, project execution, and office-level resources to ensure consistent delivery of high-quality, NETA-compliant services.

As the frontline leader of the business, the Operations Manager translates regional and divisional objectives into actionable plans—driving technician productivity, effective resource utilization, service quality, and customer satisfaction. This role is critical to maintaining EPS's reputation for technical excellence, safety leadership, and reliable execution across utility, industrial, data center, transit, and commercial markets.

##### Responsibilities

**Operational Execution & Service Delivery**

- Lead all daily operations of the local office, including scheduling, field execution, and resource allocation.
- Manage daily schedule entries and updates to ensure accurate job planning and execution. Including last-minute scheduling changes due to customer requests, site conditions, or weather.
- Assign personnel or contractors with the appropriate skill sets to meet job requirements.
- Drive technician utilization, crew productivity, and efficient project execution.
- Ensure work is completed in accordance with NETA standards, project specifications, and client expectations.
- Coordinate with engineering, project management, and regional leadership to ensure alignment.

**Financial Performance & Office-Level Accountability**

- Own office-level financial performance, including revenue, gross margin, labor efficiency, and cost control.
- Monitor profitability and margins of service work to meet business goals.
- Manage backlog execution, job costing, and forecasting accuracy.
- Prepare operational reports and forecasts outlining accomplishments, challenges, opportunities, and key initiatives.
- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and profitability and support regional growth efforts.

**Safety Leadership & Compliance**

- Champion a strong, proactive safety culture at the office and job site level.
- Ensure strict adherence to OSHA, NETA, and all company safety standards and procedures.
- Conduct jobsite safety observations, audits, and incident reviews.
- Lead by example in reinforcing zero-incident expectations and accountability.
- Perform Job Behavior Observations (JBO) regularly to provide coaching for both safety and technical aspects to the field technicians.

**People Leadership & Workforce Development**

- Hire, train, direct, and manage all field service staff within the assigned office.
- Lead, coach, and develop field technicians, supervisors, and office personnel.
- Drive recruiting, retention, workforce planning, and technical skill development.
- Ensure technicians maintain required certifications and meet training expectations.
- Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

**Customer Execution & Relationship Management**

- Interface with clients to develop solutions that meet their needs while driving bookings, growth, and profitability.
- Ensure consistent, high-quality service delivery across all customer engagements.
- Develop and maintain strong relationships with local clients and stakeholders.
- Resolve customer issues, product deficiencies, or service challenges in a timely and transparent manner.

**Planning, Coordination & Continuous Improvement**

- Manage resource utilization, including manpower, tools, vehicles, and equipment.
- Track and maintain equipment maintenance schedules to ensure operational readiness.
- Evaluate and propose capital equipment and leased equipment needs.
- Maintain weekly activity updates and coordinate reporting with the Regional Director.
- Utilize KPIs and performance metrics to drive continuous improvement and decision-making.
- Implement standardized processes and best practices across operations.

##### Qualifications

**Required:**

- Minimum 5 years' experience in electrical equipment testing and inspection, including high voltage and low voltage applications.
- B.S. in electrical Engineering or associate's degree preferred.
- NETA Certification a plus.
- Proficiency in use of Doble Power Factor Test and many other test types of test equipment, including analysis of results. Doble relay testing would be a significant plus.
- Thorough knowledge of all types of electrical equipment, installation procedures, and maintenance.
- Excellent management and supervisory skills
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- Superior safety record.
- Experience with transformers, circuit breakers, switchgears, and relays.
- Experience with budget and profit/loss responsibilities

An employee gains no status or rights as a result of the TAU appointment and an employee who has had only a TAU appointment has no reinstatement eligibility. Persons who do not possess the minimum qualifications for the classification are ineligible for appointment as a TAU.

If you are offered and accept a TAU appointment, you will be required to take the next exam administered for this classification. About Us At Field Fresh Foods, we are passionate about delivering the freshest, highest-quality produce to our customers. As a trusted industry leader, we specialize in providing customized fresh food solutions to restaurants, retailers, and food service providers. Our commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability drives everything we do.
We believe in fostering a collaborative, dynamic, and growth-oriented work environment where employees are empowered to take ownership of their roles and make a real impact. At Field Fresh Foods, you won't just have a job—you'll build a fulfilling career with opportunities for advancement, professional development, and a supportive team that values your contributions. If you’re looking to join a company that values hard work, fresh ideas, and its people, we’d love to have you on board!
Job Summary As an HR Clerk at Field Fresh Foods, you will provide essential administrative support to the Human Resources department and serve as a helpful point of contact for employees. You will assist with employee records, onboarding, recruitment, HR documentation, data entry, and general employee inquiries while helping ensure HR processes are completed accurately and on time.
The ideal candidate is organized, approachable, detail-oriented, and dependable, with strong communication skills and the ability to handle confidential employee information with professionalism and discretion.
What You’ll Do Provide day-to-day administrative support to the Human Resources team.
Assist with new-hire onboarding, including preparing paperwork, collecting required documentation, and ensuring employee records are complete.
Maintain and update employee personnel files and HR records accurately and confidentially.
Perform data entry and update employee information in the company’s HR systems.
Assist employees with general HR questions, forms, policies, and procedures, directing more complex matters to the appropriate HR team member.
Support recruiting activities, including job postings, applicant coordination, interview scheduling, and candidate communication.
Assist with new-hire orientation and other employee onboarding activities.
Prepare, organize, scan, file, and maintain HR documents and reports.
Assist with tracking employee documentation, acknowledgments, certifications, and other required records.
Support HR with attendance, timekeeping, and employee information updates as needed.
Help coordinate employee communications, meetings, training sessions, and company events.
Respond professionally to employee requests while maintaining appropriate confidentiality and discretion.
Assist the HR team with special projects and other administrative responsibilities as assigned.
What You Bring To The Table Experience: Previous Human Resources, administrative, clerical, or office support experience preferred.
Technical Skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and general computer/data-entry systems. Experience with an HRIS or HCM system is a plus.
Organization: Strong ability to organize documents, maintain accurate records, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines.
Attention to Detail: Ability to accurately enter, review, and maintain employee information and HR documentation.
Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills with a professional and approachable demeanor when assisting employees and candidates.
Customer Service: A helpful, service-oriented attitude and the ability to work effectively with employees at all levels of the organization.
Confidentiality: Ability to handle confidential and sensitive employee information with professionalism and discretion.
Teamwork: Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced HR environment while also completing assigned responsibilities independently.

Position Information

Reporting to the Director of Marketing and Communications, the Marketing Coordinator assists with all marketing and communications activities and events of the UCR School of Education (SOE), in support of its academic programs and its affiliated area groups. This role will assist with creative content, drafting of marketing and communication plans, measurement and analysis, copy writing, graphic design, email marketing, web content management, social media management, digital advertising, photography, videography, and event planning, promotion, and execution. Requires working occasional weekends and evenings for signature events. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a high level of racial literacy given that UCR is an HSI and AANAPISI institution, situated in the Inland Empire. They will be able to align Marketing priorities with the SOE mission: The University of California, Riverside's School of Education, or SOE, is a nationally recognized school in a public research university that leverages its broad range of expertise to develop impactful partnerships, collaborations, and evidence-based resources fundamental for teaching, learning, and student success. Located in a region rich in racial and linguistic diversity, yet challenged by economic and social inequities, SOE serves a diverse student population, much of which is comprised of students of color, low-income students, and first-generation college students. SOE's mission is to advance equitable educational systems and practices which are driven by core values of equity, evidence, excellence, community, critical thinking, and compassion. Additionally, we prioritize recognizing, honoring, and working with the people of the region to create transformative opportunities and advance our respective fields in education. This position is eligible for hybrid work. The full salary range for the Marketing Coordinator is $57,691.44 - $99,305.28 annually. However, the expected pay scale for this position is up to $65,000 annually. We base salary offers on a variety of considerations, such as education, licensure and certifications, experience, and other business and organizational needs. Applicants must have current work authorization when accepting a UCR staff position. Currently, we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa for staff. As a University employee, you will be required to comply with all applicable University policies and/or collective bargaining agreements, as may be amended from time to time. Federal, state, or local government directives may impose additional requirements.

# Marketing Manager

$78.5k - $82.5k

Pacific Health Group

Department: Marketing Reports To: Chief Executive Officer Classification: Exempt Work Arrangement: Hybrid ? San Diego County Compensation: $78,500.00 - $82,500.00 annually Schedule: Monday ? Friday \| Full-Time About Pacific Health Group At Pacific Health Group, we are transforming healthcare by addressing social determinants of health and delivering innovative, community-based solutions that improve lives. Through programs such as Enhanced Care Management (ECM), Community Supports, Behavioral Health Services, Community Health Workers, Street Medicine, and other whole-person care initiatives, we help individuals navigate complex healthcare systems and access the resources they need to thrive. Our mission is rooted in compassion, innovation, collaboration, and accountability. We are committed to strengthening communities, improving health outcomes, and expanding access to services through meaningful partnerships, community engagement, and strategic communication. As a rapidly growing organization, we are seeking an experienced Marketing Manager to lead brand growth, community engagement, marketing strategy, and public-facing initiatives across Pacific Health Group and affiliated entities. Position Summary The Marketing Manager is responsible for the strategic planning, development, execution, and optimization of all marketing, branding, communications, community engagement, and public relations activities across Pacific Health Group and its affiliated entities. This position serves as the operational leader of the marketing function and is responsible for driving brand awareness, community partnerships, patient and member engagement, referral source development, digital marketing initiatives, public relations efforts, and organizational visibility. The Marketing Manager collaborates closely with executive leadership, healthcare partners, community organizations, vendors, media outlets, and internal departments to ensure all marketing initiatives align with organizational goals, regulatory requirements, and brand standards. The ideal candidate is a highly organized, creative, data-driven leader with experience managing multiple projects, stakeholders, and priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Marketing Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies that support organizational growth, brand awareness, service line expansion, and community engagement.

Translate executive vision into measurable marketing initiatives and campaigns.

Lead annual and quarterly marketing planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting.

Establish marketing KPIs, dashboards, and performance metrics.

Identify new opportunities to increase organizational visibility, referral partnerships, and community impact.

Ensure alignment between marketing initiatives and organizational objectives.

Brand Management & Creative Direction

Maintain and strengthen brand integrity across all Pacific Health Group entities and affiliated organizations.

Develop and enforce brand standards, messaging frameworks, tone of voice, and visual identity guidelines.

Oversee the creation of marketing collateral, presentations, advertisements, social media content, videos, print materials, and promotional assets.

Ensure consistent branding across all digital and physical touchpoints.

Support the positioning and growth of affiliated brands while maintaining alignment with organizational objectives.

Community Engagement & Strategic Partnerships

Develop and maintain relationships with healthcare providers, managed care organizations, community-based organizations, educational institutions, workforce development agencies, and strategic partners.

Represent Pacific Health Group at networking events, conferences, community meetings, health fairs, and public engagement opportunities.

Coordinate community outreach initiatives that increase awareness of Pacific Health Group services and programs.

Identify opportunities to strengthen referral relationships and community partnerships.

Support organizational volunteer initiatives, sponsorships, and community impact programs.

Serve as a brand ambassador for Pacific Health Group throughout San Diego County and surrounding communities.

Digital Marketing & Communications

Oversee digital marketing efforts including website management, SEO, SEM, email marketing, social media management, marketing automation, and online advertising.

Monitor digital performance and continuously optimize campaigns to improve engagement and return on investment.

Manage content calendars, publication schedules, and communication strategies.

Develop and oversee organizational newsletters, email campaigns, and digital communications.

Ensure all communications are accurate, compliant, audience-focused, and aligned with organizational goals.

Public Relations & Media Relations

Develop and manage public relations strategies that enhance organizational visibility and reputation.

Coordinate media opportunities, press releases, interviews, and community announcements.

Build and maintain relationships with media outlets, journalists, and community influencers.

Support executive leadership with public-facing communications and speaking opportunities.

Assist with reputation management and crisis communication efforts when necessary.

Marketing Operations & Project Management

Manage marketing projects from concept through execution and completion.

Develop project plans, timelines, deliverables, budgets, and implementation schedules.

Coordinate multiple initiatives simultaneously while ensuring deadlines and quality standards are achieved.

Monitor project performance and provide regular updates to executive leadership.

Identify project risks and develop proactive solutions.

Ensure efficient use of marketing resources and budget allocations.

Vendor & Agency Management

Serve as the primary point of contact for marketing vendors, agencies, consultants, photographers, videographers, graphic designers, and advertising partners.

Manage vendor relationships, contracts, deliverables, timelines, and performance expectations.

Ensure all external partners meet organizational standards for quality, professionalism, and compliance.

Event Planning & Organizational Visibility

Coordinate internal and external events from planning through execution.

Support conferences, leadership speaking engagements, networking events, health fairs, ribbon cuttings, and community initiatives.

Manage event logistics, promotional materials, registrations, vendor coordination, and communications.

Measure event outcomes and identify opportunities for future growth and engagement.

Analytics & Performance Reporting

Maintain marketing dashboards and reporting systems.

Track campaign performance, engagement metrics, referral growth, digital performance, and community outreach outcomes.

Analyze marketing data and provide recommendations for continuous improvement.

Prepare executive-level reports summarizing marketing activities, results, and strategic recommendations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with Operations, Revenue Cycle, Human Resources, Behavioral Health, Community Programs, Member Services, and Executive Leadership.

Coordinate organizational initiatives that support growth, community impact, workforce development, and brand awareness.

Facilitate communication among internal stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Success in this role may be measured through:

Growth in brand awareness and community engagement.

Increased referral source development and strategic partnerships.

Campaign performance and return on investment.

Website traffic, lead generation, and digital engagement metrics.

Successful execution of events and community initiatives.

Timely completion of marketing projects and campaigns.

Growth in organizational visibility and media coverage.

Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional collaboration.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Business Administration, or a related field required.

Minimum five (5) years of progressive marketing experience.

Minimum two (2) years of leadership, project management, or team oversight experience.

Experience in healthcare, managed care, public health, behavioral health, or other regulated industries strongly preferred.

Strong knowledge of digital marketing, branding, public relations, content development, and analytics.

Experience managing vendors, agencies, and external partners.

Exceptional communication, project management, organizational, and leadership skills.

Proficiency with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, CRM platforms, marketing software, and analytics tools.

Valid California Driver's License and reliable transportation.

Preferred Qualifications

Healthcare marketing experience.

Experience working with community-based organizations and healthcare providers.

Experience supporting multiple brands or service lines.

Knowledge of HIPAA-compliant marketing practices.

Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Canva, WordPress, Google Analytics, and marketing automation platforms.

# Administrative Coordinator

Sage Compassion for Animals

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/813934166533413452?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7522597985544821894&crId=US_0US_0)

Are you looking for a career that supports animals and the people who love and depend on them? Do you find deep meaning in helping families keep their beloved pets through life's hardest moments? Sage Compassion for Animals is seeking an Administrative Coordinator who is energized by organizing internal processes across multiple functions, ensuring follow-through, and advancing a mission that truly matters.

**About Sage Compassion for Animals**

Sage Compassion for Animals (SageC4A) is a Bay Area nonprofit dedicated to keeping pets and their families together during times of crisis. We provide financial assistance for veterinary care to companion animals facing acute, life-threatening illness or injury - thereby preventing unnecessary suffering and euthanasia. We also educate communities about ways to prevent and reduce illness, and ensure all animals we help are spayed or neutered.

Founded in 2020, SageC4A is a growing organization with strong veterinary partnerships, a dedicated Board, and a donor community that shares our deep commitment to the human-animal bond. The demand for our services grows each month and we are building the processes and infrastructure to match our future vision. A strong administrative coordinator is central to this effort.

**Position Overview**

Reporting to the Executive Director, the Administrative Coordinator is a key role supporting SageC4A programs, fundraising and event functions, and marketing coordination. This is a dynamic role that blends logistics, communication, and coordination to help make sure no ball is dropped. The ideal candidate thrives in a collaborative, entrepreneurial nonprofit environment — someone who enjoys building structure, managing processes, and working closely with the entire team in a role that touches many aspects of nonprofit operations. There will be opportunity for increased responsibilities and professional growth as the organization grows.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Administration Support**

- Act as a resource to support our Healing Lives Program (offering financial assistance to pet families in need), working with the Animal Grant Program Director, clients and veterinary partners
- Work with the Animal Grant Program Director to assure necessary paperwork is filed and completed to allow issuing payment of animal grants to Veterinary Partners
- Assist in the process in following up with grantees to gain stories and images about the pets and families helped
- Learn the Healing Lives Program application process and be able to assist with grant tracking and reporting

**Development, Marketing & Event Support**

- Generate, customize, and pull reports from the donor management system to support the Development Director in fundraising analysis and campaign tracking and to support the Marketing Specialist in creating impact messaging.
- Assist the Development Director and Marketing Specialist in the execution of fundraising campaigns, donor appreciation, donor outreach, and stewardship efforts.
- Leverage SageC4A’s donor data management system (EveryAction), entering data for SageC4A donors and prospects including tracking volunteer assignments and activities, solicitations, confidential contact reports and any other pertinent information as needed.
- Help coordinate and prepare fundraising materials (appeals, email campaigns, reports).
- Support coordination of donor cultivation and appreciation events, including logistics and communication.
- Support planning and execution for community outreach and fundraising events.

**Operations & Administration**

- Keep shared documents, databases, and resources organized and accessible
- Maintain organizational timelines and project calendars
- Support compliance and documentation (e.g., bylaws, minutes, filings)

**Candidate Qualifications & Experience**

- 2+ years of experience in nonprofit, administrative, or project coordination roles.
- Skilled at using tools like Microsoft 365 (Word, Excel, Powerpoint), Google Workspace, Zoom, and CRM databases (EveryAction experience a plus).
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Able to manage multiple priorities and work independently with minimal oversight.
- Proficient in managing shared files, tracking tasks, and documenting activities.
- Passion for animal welfare or interest in the nonprofit sector is highly valued.

**What We’re Looking For**

- Comfortable working in a small, entrepreneurial nonprofit environment where flexibility and initiative are essential.
- Excellent organizational and time management skills with strong attention to detail.
- Passion for SageC4A’s mission of keeping pets and families together
- Professional judgment, discretion, and integrity

**Compensation & Details**

- Full-time, hourly
- Compensation: $25–$30 per hour depending on experience
- Remote-first position with occasional in-person event support (including weekends and evenings)
- Competitive employee benefits and policies

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit a resume and a brief cover letter to [View email address on click.appcast.io](https://jooble.org/away/813934166533413452?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=17758050&jdpSource=101&jdpid=7522597985544821894&crId=US_0US_0) describing their relevant experience and their interest in SageC4A’s mission. Come join our team and get involved with our important and mutually fulfilling mission!

# Office Administrator

DLA Piper

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-1908010284547288674?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=2241557035802878810&crId=US_0US_0)

##### Office Administrator

DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let's see what we can achieve. Together.

The Office Administrator, working in collaboration with and in support of the firm's strategic initiatives, serves as an essential leader within DLA Piper, driving administrative excellence and fostering a positive work environment. The Office Administrator embodies the core values of boldness, exceptional service, collaboration, and support, serving as a cornerstone of the firm's operational and strategic goals.

The Office administrator will be engaging directly with senior leadership, clients, and external stakeholders, this role serves as a key connector between strategic vision and day-to-day execution. The Office Administrator is instrumental in translating organizational goals into actionable outcomes, championing continuous improvement, and cultivating a high-performance culture that reflects the firm's values and priorities.

This position is based in both our Palo Alto and San Francisco offices and will require weekly travel between both office locations and offers a hybrid work schedule.

##### Responsibilities

Leadership

- Directs, manages, and oversees the daily administrative business functions of the office.
- Represents and supports firm decisions and initiatives, managing through change.
- Plans and facilitates office core management team meetings to ensure collaboration on operational excellence.
- Manages, advises, and mentors direct reports, including compensation planning, performance evaluations and onboarding.
- Holds individual meetings with each direct report for at least 30 minutes every month.
- Reports and communicates with Director of Administration, relaying information and escalating office needs, employee relations, or other issues/challenges in a timely manner.
- Influences across departments and senior staff.

Lawyer Engagement & Support

- Regularly interacts and engages with office lawyers to ensure strong practice support and proactively identify and address needs, sharing feedback across departments for continuous improvement.
- Manages, facilitates, and supports lateral integration ensuring effective collaboration of firm resources for successful practice integration into the firm.
- Plans, attends, and prepares agenda and materials for partner meetings, presenting on business and financial matters, as needed.
- Partners with talent acquisition, practice group, and/or local office partners for lateral recruiting efforts and initiatives and onboarding of new associates.

Strategic Partnership

- Collaborates with OMP and marketing and business development on office marketing budget and client-facing and business development opportunities, which may include managing contracts for strategic utilization of sports tickets to maximize ROI.
- Partners with various departments on office events and initiatives to maximize engagement and build/maintain a positive office culture.
- Helps improve the firm's brand recognition in the community through civic involvement and local networking and collaborating with the firm's Alumni team.
- Partners with the firm's Real Estate leadership team and Operations on space planning to include refurbishing projects, moves, subleasing, space layout, plan review, construction RFPs and construction management and external use of office space.
- Participates in firmwide initiatives with department leadership and senior management.
- The OA will serve as a key partner to the Director of Administration, contributing to one or more strategic functional areas within the department, which may include:

 - Attorney & Business Professional Relationship Management.
 - Process Improvement & Technology (AI).
 - Communications & Leadership Liaison.
 - Talent Management: Recruiting, Training & Development.
 - Manages complex workflows and broader impact.

Financial Responsibility

- In alignment with firm initiatives, supports and drives efforts around billing and collections to optimize cash conversion and meet office goals.
- Works collaboratively with Practice Group Directors to partner with lawyers to ensure the implementation of best practices in fiscal management.
- Prepares, analyzes, and maintains accurate office administration and related office budgets for all areas of responsibility.

##### Desired Skills

Demonstrated ability to assume a leadership role and make decisions while fostering a teamwork environment. Ability to adapt to changing priorities and maintain a productive and committed work effort, meeting deadlines and managing workload. Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly and professionally, both orally and in writing. Demonstrated ability to provide quality client service to both internal and external contacts regarding administrative matters of a complex nature. Requires patience, creativity, discretion, and the ability to negotiate and influence change. Demonstrated ability to effectively supervise others, including hiring, training, assigning work, managing performance, and counseling. Ability to lead others in the development of a cohesive, effective work unit.

Basic understanding of local and national labor laws, HR practices, and legal requirements. Possess knowledge of basic accounting and budgeting principles and the ability to track, organize, analyze, and report financial data clearly. Elevated level of knowledge of MS Suite to prepare a variety of business communications.

##### Minimum Education

- High School Diploma or GED.

##### Preferred Education

- Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Finance or related field.

##### Minimum Years of Experience

- 6 years' management experience in a professional services or law firm environment, preferred. Experience with facilities management to include design, construction, contract negotiations and project management a plus. Knowledge of basic accounting principles to include budget management required.

##### Essential Job Expectations

While the specific job requirements of a DLA Piper position may vary depending upon scope of the job and area of specialty, there are certain universal requirements that are expected of all DLA Piper employees, which include but are not limited to:

- Effectively communicate, verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and third parties.
- Produce deliverables, answer phone calls, and reply to correspondence in an efficient and responsive manner.
- Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product.
- Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required.
- Foster positive work relationships.
- Comply with all firm policies and practices.
- Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed.
- Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment.
- Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.

Work Environment

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm's discretion in the future.

##### Master Clinical Scheduler @ Midi Health:

##### Who we are:

Midi Health is the only comprehensive virtual care clinic for women in midlife navigating perimenopause, menopause, and other common midlife health challenges. Our platform provides care designed by experts, scaled by technology, and delivered by trained and compassionate clinicians.

##### Where we’re based:

We are an entirely virtual company, so employees can live anywhere in the United States.

##### Who you are:

Midi is seeking an experienced Master Scheduler to join our cutting edge healthcare start-up. This is a rare opportunity to start at the ground level of a fast-growing healthcare practice. We offer a flexible work schedule and 100% remote environment.

##### Core Responsibilities

- Process clinician time off, schedule changes, and Clinician Hub requests following established guidelines.
- Complete assigned queue expectations, updating availability, administrative blocks, and recurring adjustments.
- Manage patient rescheduling workflows resulting from schedule updates.
- Maintain accurate documentation and ticket categorization.
- Prioritize requests by urgency and patient impact, maintaining ownership through resolution and escalating barriers promptly.

##### Cross-Functional Responsibilities

Team members may be cross-trained and assigned across Scheduling work-streams based on business need, volume, coverage, and demonstrated proficiency. This may include:

- Urgent Scheduling Support: Manage urgent callouts, disruptions, and time-sensitive patient rescheduling.
- Schedule Building: Build and maintain schedules, templates, appointment durations, and ramp schedules, auditing for accuracy.
- Queue Flexing & Coverage: Adapt dynamically across queues and provide backup support during PTO, volume spikes, or launches.
- Special Projects & Learning: Support onboarding/offboarding, process testing, cleanups, and ongoing cross-training.

Note: Scheduling Specialists are expected to maintain proficiency across multiple workflows, with primary assignments shifting based on operational demand.

##### Minimum Requirements

The qualified candidate will have experience in the following:

- Minimum of 1 year experience working for a digital healthcare company is required
- Minimum of five (5) years as a Clinical Scheduler building clinician schedules in AthenaHealth
- 5+ years using AthenaHealth (Athena) required
- Proficiency in scheduling across multiple time zones
- Strong attention to detail

##### Hours

The scheduling commitment for this role is as follows: Sunday through Thursday, 9:30am - 6pm PST.

##### What we offer

- Compensation: $30/hour, non-exempt
- Full Time, 40-hour work-week
- Fully remote, work from home opportunity with a work-from-home monthly stipend
- Benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401k)

At this time, Midi is unable to provide visa sponsorship. All Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship needs.

Please note that all official communication from Midi Health will come from an **@joinmidi.com** email address. We will never ask for payment of any kind during the application or hiring process. ## Administrative Assistant

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to provide administrative and operational support to ensure daily activities run smoothly. The ideal candidate is proactive, reliable, and comfortable managing multiple tasks, coordinating schedules, organizing information, and communicating with internal teams and external contacts.

### Responsibilities

- Provide general administrative and operational support to the team.
- Manage calendars, schedules, meetings, and appointments.
- Organize and maintain digital files, documents, records, and databases.
- Prepare, format, and update documents, reports, presentations, and spreadsheets.
- Respond to emails, messages, and routine inquiries in a timely and professional manner.
- Coordinate meetings, calls, and other team activities.
- Assist with data entry, document processing, and maintaining accurate records.
- Track deadlines, tasks, and follow-ups to ensure timely completion.
- Coordinate information and requests between internal teams and external contacts.
- Assist with travel arrangements, expenses, invoices, or other administrative tasks when required.
- Maintain confidentiality when handling company and business information.
- Identify administrative issues and help implement efficient solutions.
- Support managers and team members with day-to-day administrative needs.
- Follow company procedures and maintain organized and accurate administrative processes.

### Required Skills

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Strong organizational and time-management skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Strong ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office or Google Workspace.
- Comfortable using email, calendars, spreadsheets, document management systems, and other digital tools.
- Strong data entry and document management skills.
- Ability to communicate professionally with internal and external stakeholders.
- Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.
- Ability to work independently and take initiative.
- Discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.

### Requirements

- Previous experience as an Administrative Assistant, Office Assistant, Executive Assistant, Coordinator, or in a similar administrative role.
- Experience managing schedules, documents, emails, and administrative tasks.
- Strong computer and digital skills.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a remote team.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Reliable internet connection and a suitable setup for remote work.
- Professional, proactive, organized, and dependable attitude.
- English proficiency is required if the position involves communicating with English-speaking clients, managers, or teams.

By applying to this position, we'll create your Simera Professional Key (SPK) a unique key that helps you connect with employers, stand out, and secure the right match.
