About the job Online Administrative Assistant - Remote
Plans, directs, and oversees the development, implementation, and maintenance of the District's comprehensive records management program to ensure compliance with established standards.Oversees and monitors the work schedules of the Administrative Assistant positions (I-III) to ensure adequate coverage at all times. Provides input on the annual performance evaluations of the Administrative Assistant (I-III) positions.

Distinguishing Characteristics

This is a records specialist classification with senior level administrative and functional supervisory duties.
Supervision Received and Exercised Receives general supervision from the Office Manager/Secretary to the Board. May receive functional supervision from other managers, and may exercise functional supervision over Administrative Assistant positions (I-III).

Primary Duties

Records Management and Information Center Administration:

Utilizes records management software to monitor and manage the day-to-day activities of the Records Center(s).

Drafts and implements District-wide Records Management Program and uniform filing procedures.

Follows procedures to properly create, code, catalog, identify, archive, maintain, relocate, and dispose of records and related information.

Retrieves, refiles, locates, and recovers missing records.

Directs, coordinates, and trains departmental records coordinators and other staff as needed in accessing materials, operating records retrieval software, and applying records management procedures to specific records.

Prepares reports of program activity and outstanding files; conducts records audit(s) as required.

Locates materials; checks in and out and retrieves as needed.

Drafts proposals for comprehensive new or revised policies and procedures to be applied in records management systems; distributes and coordinates review and approval process

Analyzes records retrieval, access, storage, media, and disposal requirements; evaluates costs and operations of commercially available records management vendors.

Recommends vendors and services for purchase; coordinates installation of systems and/or activates and monitors service delivery.

Orders and maintains record center supplies and inventory levels.

**Administrative Duties:**

May provide direction in coordinating and prioritizing the daily work of the Administrative Assistants. May instruct lower level personnel in the performance of assigned work projects or activities.

Develops work schedules and coordinates coverage for leaves and absences of Administrative Assistants. Reviews leave requests, and modified works schedules to ensure proper coverage prior to the Director's approval.

Assists in determining the training needs of the Administrative Assistants. Coordinates, schedules and provides necessary training and equipment, as needed.

Assists in providing guidance and training to lower level personnel to address performance and behavior problems. Makes recommendations on corrective or disciplinary action to the Directors/Department Heads, as needed.

Provides input on the performance evaluations of the Administrative Assistant (I-III) positions to the Directors/Department Heads

Assists in the development and implementation of Administrative Procedures.

Receives, reviews pricing accuracy, and distributes Administrative invoices for processing. Monitors Administrative Purchase Order terms.

Serves as primary backup for Office Manager/Secretary to the Board position, including administrative support to the General Manager and Board of Directors. Duties may include meeting agenda preparation, attending meetings, and taking minutes or producing other Board of Directors meeting documentation.May participate in the recruitment process of temporary employees and regular administrative staff.

The Executive Assistant will provide an efficient and professional administrative support service to fee earners. Ensure telephones are covered and answered promptly and professionally at all times.
Understand and contribute towards team objectives.
Work flexibly and outside core hours as and when the need arises to meet deadlines and complete tasks.

Handle expense management on behalf of fee earners, submitting claims on a weekly basis.
Business Development Maintain a good knowledge of key clients and awareness of the firm’s and of their fee earners’ strategic objectives.
Maintain a good understanding of K/BD (knowledge and business development?) resources and best practices.
Manage contacts in Outlook and Connect for fee earners and assist in client development outreach
Assists fee earners and MBD department with the production of marketing, including production of pitches, client presentations and maintaining up‑to‑date CVs.
Assist with client events as and when required.

Excellent communication skills, both written and oral with an ability to interact at all levels.
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships with key stakeholders and clients.
Ability to demonstrate absolute discretion with sensitive and confidential information.
Independent self starter able to problem solve and take full ownership of assigned tasks.
An enthusiastic and committed approach, whilst remaining flexible and proactive at all times.
An ability to work well in pressured situations while maintaining a professional attitude.
Able to work fast, accurately and to tight deadlines.
Ability to prioritize tasks, conflicting demands and deadlines and act on own initiative.
A strong team player with an ability to form supportive relationships throughout the firm.
Adaptable and open to change.
Willingness to broaden experience and develop skills further.

# Executive Assistant to Sales Leadership

$100k - $155k

Full-time

Ouster

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6151276038114132345?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=690&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-3989058330141641734&crId=US_0US_0)

## At Ouster, we build sensors and tools for engineers, roboticists, and researchers, so they can make the world safer and more efficient. We've transformed LIDAR from an analog device with thousands of components to an elegant digital device powered by one chip-scale laser array and one CMOS sensor. The result is a full range of high-resolution LIDAR sensors that deliver superior imaging at a dramatically lower price. Our advanced sensor hardware and vision algorithms are used in autonomous cars, drones and many other applications. If you’re motivated by solving big problems, we’re hiring key roles across the company and need your help! Position Overview We are seeking an exceptionally organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to support our Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) and the broader team of Sales and Marketing Vice Presidents. In this critical role, you will serve as an operational force multiplier across our entire commercial organization. You will streamline executive calendars, coordinate global travel and key leadership syncs, drive logistics for high-stakes customer visits and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and manage tactical workstreams in sales enablement and tool administration. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced sales environment, excels at managing competing priorities, and possesses the discretion, communication skills, and initiative required to interact with key clients, internal executives, and global cross-functional partners.

## Key Responsibilities:

### Executive & Administrative Support for Sales Leadership:

1. Calendar Management & Schedule Optimization: Oversee complex, back-to-back schedules for the CRO and VP of Marketing across multiple global time zones (US, APAC, EMEA). Strategically protect focus time for executive strategy, slide deck preparation, and budget reviews.
2. Cross-Functional Action Item Tracking: Attend key leadership syncs and cross-functional meetings; capture action items, update project trackers, and proactively follow up with owners across PR, Creative, Product, Finance, and Legal.
3. Travel & Expense Management: Coordinate end-to-end travel logistics (flights, hotels, transport) for domestic and international sales trips and trade shows. Manage expense approvals, receipt collection compliance (via RAMP), and credit card program setups.
4. Vendor & Procurement Logistics: Assist with agency onboarding, Statement of Work (SOW) tracking, and invoice processing for key marketing and sales partners.

### Sales Enablement & Commercial Operational Workstreams:

- Customer On-Site Visits & Executive Events: Serve as the primary point of contact for Account Executives (AEs) hosting clients on-site. Own conference room bookings, visitor access, and catering setups.
- QBR & All-Hands Ownership:
 - Commercial Leadership Team (CLT) QBRs: Own end-to-end logistics including calendar management, distributing deck templates to Sales VPs, confirming external speakers, and organizing offsite activities, daily lunches, and team dinners.
 - GEO QBR Coordination: Manage template distribution to Geo VPs whenever updates occur, enabling regional VPs to handle localized scheduling seamlessly.
 - Commercial All-Hands: Monitor earnings call dates to schedule All-Hands meetings 1–2 weeks post-earnings. Build draft slide decks using existing templates and compile inputs from CLT members.

- Sales Enablement Tool Administration: Provision and manage user onboarding/offboarding for revenue team tools, specifically Clari and LinkedIn Sales Navigator , to ensure seamless sales onboarding.
- Field Sales & Team Directory Administration:
 - Oversee edits, approvals, and ordering for Field Operations and Sales team business cards.
 - Maintain a centralized team profile directory containing updated headshots, active org charts, team bios, and standardized executive/technical resumes.
 - Maintain an accurate team calendar tracking vacation blocks, maternity leave, coverage plans, and trade show travel across the department.

## Qualifications & Requirements:

- Experience: 4+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Sales Operations Coordinator, or similar role supporting C-suite or VP-level sales executives, preferably within a tech or high-growth B2B environment.
- Tech Savvy: Proficiency with Google Workspace, project tracking tools, expense management platforms (e.g., RAMP), and revenue enablement software ( Clari , LinkedIn Sales Navigator ).
- Event & Logistics Mastery: Proven track record of managing large-scale executive offsites, QBRs, customer visits, and commercial events from concept to completion.
- Communication & Discretion: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with high emotional intelligence, professionalism, and strict confidentiality.
- Detail-Oriented & Self-Driven: Ability to ruthlessly prioritize in a high-velocity sales environment, anticipate leadership needs before they arise, and track complex action items across cross-functional departments.

## Why Join Us?

- High Impact: Serve as the backbone of operational efficiency for our executive sales and commercial leadership team.
- Growth & Visibility: Gain broad exposure to global go-to-market strategies, sales enablement, and executive leadership operations.
- Culture: A collaborative, dynamic environment where execution, organization, and proactive problem-solving are valued and rewarded.

The base pay will be dependent on your skills, work experience, location, and qualifications. This role may also be eligible for equity & benefits. ($100,000 - $155,000)

## Fiscal Clerk

Ocean Bay, LLC, a subsidiary of Three Saints Bay, LLC and a Federal Government Contractor industry leader, has an opening for a highly motivated Fiscal Clerk located in San Francisco, CA.

The successful candidate will have a solid background in financial administration, office operations, and fiscal support, with experience processing financial transactions while ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficient business operations. The Fiscal Clerk will perform a wide range of administrative, office and professional support activities.

Position Responsibilities:

- Provides oversight and administrative support in the planning, execution, analysis, and tracking of resources.
- Develop plans including budgets allocations and schedules to meet various operational requirements.
- Conducts in-depth analysis of a wide variety of sources, studies and/or audits as established/planned in the program requirements.
- Evaluates, monitors, and reports performance against plans to ensure guidelines meet appropriate procedures and policies.
- Perform data entry and ensure accuracy and consistency across all databases and reports.
- Conduct research and develop spreadsheets, tracking systems, and presentations for management use.
- Support financial tracking activities and assist in budget planning and resource allocation.
- Assist in processing invoices, purchase requests, and vendor payments.
- Track office budgets and maintain financial records.
- Monitor expenditures and ensure spending aligns with budget allocations.
- Maintain financial spreadsheets, logs, and supporting documentation.
- Review and verify reports for accuracy; reconcile inconsistencies.
- Assist with inventory control and property accountability.
- Prepare routing financial reports and status updates for management.
- Ensure compliance with agency policies, financial regulations, and internal controls.
- Schedule meetings, maintain files, and provide general administrative support.
- Respond to inquiries regarding financial transactions and office expenditure.

Position Requirements:

- Minimum of a bachelor's degree or equivalent.
- Must have 4 years of relevant experience.
- Position requires strong analytical, interpersonal, oral and written communication skills, and the ability to solve complex problems and work in a team environment.
- Preferred knowledge of financial and procurement processes.

Skills:

- Experience with Microsoft Teams and SharePoint management and computer software programs.
- Must be proficient in the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).
- Possess knowledge of applying analytic methodologies and principles to address program needs.

Security Requirements :

Security Clearance Level: Public Trust

- Applicants selected will be subject to a government background investigation and must meet eligibility and suitability requirements.
- Must be a US Citizen with the ability to obtain a US Government security clearance.
- Successful Pass of Ocean Bay, LLC. Background Investigation, Drug Screening, and Credit Check.

Position Location: San Francisco, CA

Anticipated Salary Range: $60,000.00 - $66,500.00

### Job Description

Job Description

**Job:** Accounts Payable Specialist

**Location:** San Francisco, CA

**Onsite:** 1x in office per week

**Hourly Pay:** $30-$38 / hour, depending on experience

**Benefits:** This position is eligible for medical, dental, vision, and 401(k).

Our San Francisco based client is looking for an Accounts Payable consultant to assist for 6 months as the team works through upcoming deadlines. This is a contract role with the possibility to extend, depending on the needs of the team. This will require the candidate to work onsite in San Francisco, CA at least 1 day per week.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Full cycle invoice processing
- Review invoices for accuracy, completeness, and approval compliance.
- Enter invoices into system and ensure correct GL coding.
- Performing 3-way matching - match invoices to purchase orders (POs), receiving documentation, and inventory item.
- Process invoice approvals and resolve discrepancies with vendors.
- Maintain vendor records, including collecting W9 forms for year end 1099 filing.
- Prepare and process payments (checks, ACH, wires).
- Maintain AP aging reports.
- Assist with account reconciliations and monthly close tasks.

**Requirements:**

- Experience with full cycle invoice processing.
- Experience with 3-way matching and processing invoices related to inventory.
- Experience working in a larger ERP system (NetSuite, Oracle Fusion/Cloud, Bill.com, Coupa, etc.).
- Must be able to work independently.

### Job Description

Job Description

**Job Title:** Project Planner (Intermediate & Senior)

**Sector:** Biotechnology / Life Sciences

**Location:** USA (Remote & On-site)

**Job Description:**

PDP is hiring Intermediate & Senior Project Planners to support multiple projects both supporting & leading planning teams with relevant clients in the United States.

These individuals shall report to the PDP Project controls manager. The Planners, in conjunction with the relevant planning teams, have a primary objective to support the engineering, procurement, construction and Commissioning (EPCmV) group in the planning, and execution of large-scale CAPEX projects by providing management with critical, decision-making information that ensures projects deliver on time.

The Project Planner function includes advanced planning, scheduling, progress measurement, change management implementation and analysis that may involve a major project or several smaller projects. A thorough understanding is required of policies, methods, and procedures that includes advanced Planning and Scheduling techniques, Risk Analysis, Risk Management, and support of project objectives. The Planner will provide expertise and best practice implementation in the workplace for the region with regard to the planning and scheduling discipline.

**Main Responsibilities**

- Expertise in project controls and time/schedule management is required preferably within the Pharma/ Biotech or associated sectors.
- Expert experience level using project scheduling tools (MS Project, Primavera P6), Excel, PowerPoint and Pertmaster.
- Ability to coordinate/organize multiple sources of schedule inputs/performance data into a master schedule platform and deliver project/program status reports as required.
- Implement Project Planning/Scheduling strategy, plans and procedures, reflecting both Company and contractor roles, responsibilities and expectations.
- Coordinate the development and implementation of project Work Breakdown Structures (WBS).
- Perform probabilistic analysis on integrated schedules and contractor schedules.
- Conduct the required project schedule analysis, critical path analysis and schedule risk analysis for the project as a whole.
- Analyze deviations from the baseline in the Project Master schedule highlighting bottlenecks / delays and propose corrective actions.
- Prepare the Integrated Planning / Scheduling contribution to the Monthly Project Report and specific reports / presentations.
- Analyze and highlight the overall schedule impact of any variance / change order.
- Prepare resourcing plans for the overall and individual project phases, identifying any excessive peak numbers and making recommendations for peak leveling.
- Ensure that schedule related data from vendors, suppliers, engineering and construction contractors is aligned and integrated to the overall Integrated Master Schedule.
- Ensure the accuracy and completeness of the schedules produced, maintaining independence as a planning engineer when advising on issues requiring judgment.
- Ability to balance multiple projects executed in multiple locations and by multiple contractors.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
- Develops good working relationships with project team
- Other work as needed in support of successful project delivery.

**Qualifications**

- 5 - 10 years of experience in CAPEX projects with roles in planning/scheduling: preferably in Biotech or Pharmaceutical industries.

- Significant experience in schedule set up, baselining, monitoring and controlling on large scale projects across the all phases of EPCmV.
- Comprehensive understanding of risk and change management.
- Demonstrated problem-solving ability in cross-functional environment.
- Advanced MS Excel.
- Software systems and packages including Primavera P6
- Ability to work within a high-performance, cross-functional organization with extremely tight timelines and aggressive goals.
- Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
- Good Level in English, written and spoken.

Pride Global

### Job Description

Job Description

**Workplace Operations Coordinator**

**Location:** San Francisco, CA 94105 — Onsite

**Openings:** 2

**Contract:** 6-month W2 contract

**Pay:** $70–$80/hour depending on experience

Russell Tobin is hiring **Workplace Operations Coordinators** to support a leading technology and artificial intelligence organization in San Francisco.

This role is ideal for an experienced workplace or facilities professional who enjoys creating a safe, functional, welcoming, and high-performing office environment. You’ll work closely with internal workplace teams, Security, People Operations, and external vendors to support day-to-day building operations and deliver a consistently high level of service to employees.

**What You’ll Do**

- Coordinate and manage vendors supporting day-to-day office operations, including deliveries, office supplies, janitorial services, maintenance, and repairs.
- Partner with the broader workplace team to ensure office buildings remain safe, functional, comfortable, and well maintained.
- Respond to employee workplace requests through an internal ticketing system while meeting service-level expectations and providing clear, timely communication.
- Troubleshoot and coordinate resolution of workplace issues such as elevator outages, plumbing concerns, refrigeration problems, lighting issues, and other facilities-related needs.
- Perform minor repairs and maintenance tasks and engage appropriate vendors for more complex work.
- Support emergency response activities in partnership with Security and assist with local safety and code-compliance requirements.
- Manage multiple competing priorities and exercise sound judgment when determining urgency and next steps.
- Set up furniture and room configurations for onsite meetings, events, and employee needs.
- Complete workstation setups, including monitors, monitor arms, ergonomic equipment, and related office hardware.
- Help maintain workplace Standard Operating Procedures and operational documentation.
- Partner closely with People Operations, Security, workplace colleagues, and external service providers.
- Support HVAC coordination, preventive maintenance programs, office moves, restacks, and space reconfigurations.
- Assist with permits, inspections, safety requirements, and applicable building-code compliance.

**What We’re Looking For**

- 4+ years of experience in workplace operations, facilities coordination, building operations, office services, or a related field.
- Working knowledge of commercial building systems such as HVAC, elevators, plumbing, lighting, and related facilities infrastructure.
- Experience coordinating maintenance, repairs, vendors, and building services.
- Strong customer-service mindset with a practical, solutions-oriented approach.
- Ability and willingness to handle both hands-on operational tasks and administrative coordination.
- Excellent organization, communication, and prioritization skills.
- Comfortable managing multiple requests in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment.
- Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
- Ability to work onsite in San Francisco.

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience managing workplace or facilities projects such as preventive maintenance, HVAC initiatives, office moves, restacks, or space reconfigurations.
- Experience supporting multiple buildings or a rapidly growing workplace environment.
- Background in vendor management, hospitality, food and beverage operations, or employee experience.
- Experience coordinating permits, licenses, inspections, or building-compliance requirements.
- Experience supporting workplace operations within a technology, software, startup, or similarly fast-paced organization.

This is a hands-on role for someone who takes pride in making workplaces run smoothly and creating an environment where employees can focus, collaborate, and do their best work.

# Business Operations Manager

$85k - $95k

Rocketship Public Schools

##### Rocketship Public Schools Business Operations Manager

At Rocketship Public Schools, we believe in the infinite possibility of human potential. We believe that every student deserves the right to dream, to discover, and to develop their unique potential and it is our responsibility and our privilege to unleash the potential inside every Rocketeer we serve. Our non-profit network of public elementary charter schools propels student achievement, develops exceptional educators, and partners with parents who enable high-quality public schools to thrive in their community. We are a collective of parents, teachers, leaders, and students working together to transform the future for underserved communities across our country. At Rocketship Public Schools, we are unleashing potential.

Rocketship school leadership teams each include a Principal and Assistant Principals focused on instruction, an Office Manager focused on student information and family engagement, and a school leader focused on all other operations aspects of running the school -- what some might call an "AP of Operations," though we at Rocketship call it a Business Operations Manager (BOM). The BOM reports directly to the Principal and manages a team of hourly Operations Specialists. As the Operations leader, the BOM is responsible for all aspects of student meals, recess, arrival, dismissal, physical space, and safety at their campus. Thus, the role requires not only the ability to manage "business" topics like logistics and compliance, but also a deep understanding of behavior management, culture-setting, and behavior management coaching. The BOM helps ensure the school has a consistent culture across spaces, keeps our students safe, and ultimately enables instructional staff to focus on teaching and learning. This means BOMs are multi-talented leaders who can build systems, own processes like procurement and facilities maintenance, and partner with all adults on campus to support our students. The BOM role is an excellent opportunity for operationally-minded teachers and school leaders who want to grow and develop through an operational school leadership position.

Essential Functions

- Own the logistics, staffing, and daily management of arrival, lunch, recess, dismissal and physical space at your campus; ensuring joy and safety exude in all systems!
- Coach Operations Specialists daily in behavior management techniques, through both "in-the-moment coaching" and planned 1:1s.
- Design and lead professional development for Operations Specialists focused on behavior management skill development.
- Manage the physical space of the building and all facilities-related needs, including scheduling/meeting vendors and handling after-hours facilities emergencies.
- Manage food service operations, including managing staff, serving as the main contact with meal vendor, ensuring compliance, conducting internal audits, and ensuring meal program financial health.

Compliance & Budget

- Ensure your campus is financially responsible by providing support to the Principal on finance-related topics, including around budgets, cash collection, and invoice approval.
- Serve as the main owner of school safety processes and compliance, including administering training and running safety drills. Partner with the Principal to respond to emergencies.
- Own procurement and purchasing for the school site. Work with Principal to understand needs, place orders, inventory items received, handle returns/exchanges, etc.
- Serve as on-site IT contact, including managing IT assets, assisting staff with IT issues as able, and serving as the main touchpoint to central IT staff.
- Support the logistical, compliance, and technology side of administration of Rocketship's assessments, including NWEA MAP and state tests, and health screenings like hearing and vision.
- CA Only: Own free/reduced-price lunch application process, including validating forms and running income verification process.

Leadership & Management

- Exhibit Rocketship's core values daily: authenticity, community, innovation, tenacity, and pursuit of excellence.
- Hire, manage, and evaluate all hourly school Operations Specialists. Drive Operations Specialist satisfaction and development through active investment in your team.
- Be a collaborative and supportive partner on your school's leadership team and the national Business Operations Manager team.
- Engage with parents on operational topics, demonstrating a clear customer service mindset that honors and engages our students' families.
- Have the opportunity to be the campus COVID Lead as we navigate and adapt our staff and student facing procedures to ensure our campuses mitigate the risk of COVID-19

Required Qualifications

- Minimum 5 years of relevant experience, with school-based experience strongly preferred. Many of our most successful BOMs have previously been teachers and/or school leaders in other roles.
- Managerial experience is strongly preferred. Leadership and/or coaching roles among other adults can potentially substitute for this.
- Experience in a fast-paced, highly analytical, entrepreneurial environment. Ability to proactively manage multiple critical deadlines and quickly and confidently adapt to changing school needs, independently prioritizing and following through on completion of tasks and responsibilities. Demonstrated ability to be detail-oriented, organized, and resourceful.
- Team-player attitude and strong customer-service orientation. Skill at communicating respectfully and empathetically with students' families. Spanish language proficiency preferred in many of our communities, but not required.
- Skilled at building strong and trusting working relationships with people in both senior- and junior-level roles, both within and beyond Rocketship. Ability to treat sensitive issues with respect and empathy, and maintain strict confidentiality where required.
- Strong PC-based computer skills, including the ability to use spreadsheets and the Google Suite, and ability to quickly become proficient in new software programs.
- Passion for Rocketship's mission, and the belief that all students can achieve high levels of academic success.

$85,000 - $95,000 a year Commensurate with qualifications and experience, plus excellent health and wellness benefits, 403b retirement plan, flexible spending account (FSA), and generous paid time off.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including, but not limited to, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Rocketship Public Schools expressly prohibits any form of unlawful employee harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. At the University of California, Berkeley, we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom and belonging make it a special place for students, faculty and staff.

As a world-leading institution, Berkeley is known for its academic and research excellence, public mission, diverse student body, and commitment to equity and social justice. Since our founding in 1868, we have driven innovation, creating global intellectual, economic and social value.

We are looking for applicants who reflect California's diversity and want to be part of an inclusive, equity-focused community that views education as a matter of social justice. Please consider whether your values align with our Guiding Values and Principles , Principles of Community , and Strategic Plan .

At UC Berkeley, we believe that learning is a fundamental part of working, and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups (staff organizations). Our goal is for everyone on the Berkeley campus to feel supported and equipped to realize their full potential. We actively support this by providing all of our full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours (10 days) of paid time per year to engage in professional development activities. Find out more about how you can grow your career at UC Berkeley.

**Departmental Overview**

The University of California Police Department provides a full range of law enforcement services in support of the academic and public service missions of the University of California, serving a diverse community of more than 43,000 students and 14,000 faculty & staff in the vibrant City of Berkeley, at the heart of the San Francisco Bay Area. In addition to the traditional role of a police department, we also carry out a variety of proactive educational, outreach and crime prevention programs. We pride ourselves in a professional and high-quality delivery of service, which we provide with sensitivity to the unique concerns of the University community.

At the Berkeley campus, we employ approximately 44 sworn peace officers, 70 full time civilian employees and 75 part-time students. We are interested in ethical, intelligent, creative and motivated candidates who possess the desire and talent required to address the unique challenges of our urban campus environment. We offer a wide variety of assignments and a public service experience unlike any other agency.

**Position Summary**

Under general supervision, incumbents receive and relay calls for assistance via telephone, radio, and computer terminal; answer and/or redirect calls for information; establish priority and dispatch emergency calls; monitor, acknowledge, and input computerized alarm data; monitor and respond to video display activity; track and document all related activities; access, report, and update automated criminal records; receive, dispatch, and maintain hard copy records; research and compose reports and communications equipment as required.

Incumbents may also handle direct citizen requests and staff mobile and remote communications command posts during special events and emergencies.

**Application Review Date**

The First Review Date for this job is: 01/22/2026. This is an ongoing hiring process with multiple positions available. Applications will be regularly assessed, and hiring will occur at various points throughout the year. The job listing will remain open for as long as applications are accepted.

**Responsibilities**

- Public Safety Dispatchers, working in campus safety communications centers, receive calls for assistance and information; dispatch police, emergency medical aid and fire response; provide related automated data search and entry; monitor various alarm systems; and track and document field unit activities and locations.
- Public Safety Dispatchers typically answer telephones, respond to analog and digital alarms, operate a variety of two-way, multi-frequency radio equipment to dispatch and communicate with police officers, emergency medical personnel, fire fighters, hazardous material response teams, parking enforcement officers, community service officers, and civilian department employees.
- Dispatchers are responsible for assessing the nature and priority of calls for assistance, determining and assigning the appropriate resources, tracking and documenting the resulting response and disposition on both hard copy and computerized media.
- Dispatchers research and report automated and hard copy records relating to public safety operations, input and update local, state and Federal criminal records, maintain security of confidential records, purge and destroy confidential records in accordance with law, compile and maintain resource files, develop, apply and update training manuals and records and train and evaluate staff members. \*(Training-related duties are only for designated/assigned trainers).

**Required Qualifications**

- Applicants for positions in the Public Safety Dispatcher series are expected to possess the skills, knowledge, and abilities essential to the successful performance of the duties assigned to the position.
- Minimum qualifications for Public Safety Dispatcher include satisfactory completion of a POST- certified, 120-hour Public Safety Dispatchers' Basic Course within 12 months of the date of hire; undergo a thorough background investigation; an evaluation of oral communication skills; the completion of 12 months' probation; and the completion of a medical examination.
- Applicants must obtain a passing score on either the POST Written Dispatch test or the CritiCall Dispatch test.
- Must complete the Public Safety Dispatchers' Basic Course and obtain certification.
- High school diploma and/or equivalent certification/experience/training.

**Salary & Benefits**

For information on the comprehensive benefits package offered by the University, please visit the University of California's Compensation & Benefits website.

Under California law, the University of California, Berkeley is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role and should not offer a salary outside of the range posted in this job announcement. This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, analysis of internal equity, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be offered a salary at or near the top of the range for a position. Salary offers are determined based on final candidate qualifications and experience.

The budgeted hourly range that the University reasonably expects to pay for this position is $41.56 - $55.40.

- This is a full-time (40 hours/week), career position that is eligible for UC Benefits.
- This is a non-exempt, biweekly-paid position.

**How to Apply**

- To apply, please submit your resume and cover letter.

Berkeley does hire people with conviction histories and reviews information received in the context of the job responsibilities. The University reserves the right to make employment contingent upon successful completion of the background check.

**Physical Exam**

- Employment is contingent upon passing a drug screen/physical/psychological exam.

We reserve the right to make employment contingent upon completion of signed statements acknowledging the responsibilities of a Mandated Reporter.

# Marketing Coordinator

$75.92k - $105.59k

Boston Properties

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-376704741282867208?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-5768808415704684330&crId=US_0US_0)

**Job Description**

**Primary Purpose of Position:**

Coordinate and implement office, retail, and community marketing initiatives for assigned properties.

**Essential Functions:**

**Marketing**

- Assist in the planning and execution of promotions and events to increase traffic and engagement for the assigned properties, including office client, community, and visitor engagement
- Oversee signage program which includes maps, directories, and retail promotional signage, if applicable. Coordinate updates regularly
- Maintains websites and social media; tracks basic engagement metrics and ensures content accuracy
- Assist in planning and execution of the assigned properties social media campaigns throughout the year, including content creation, social partnerships, effective data tracking and social media reporting
- Promote and publicize new amenities and community offerings, informing the general public, office clients, and the hospitality industry
- Proof composite campaign designs; create a wide range of different marketing materials
- Develop and maintain positive relationships with retailers; coordinate programs and promotions and market services to retailers
- Participate in the ideation, planning and execution of annual office client appreciation events and promotions
- Coordinate new office client onboarding/welcome materials and welcome events

**Events, Communications & Public Relations**

- Coordinate and execute events, promotions, and campaigns in assigned properties with strong attention to detail; manages vendors, timelines, and on-site delivery
- Communicate consistently and effectively with customers, retailers and employees to educate them on marketing programs, obtain their participation, and assist them with questions, concerns or problems
- Assist in creating and maintaining positive relations with office clients and retailers via regular proactive communication, meetings and routine follow-up.
- Assist with prospecting of potential advertisers and sponsors for assigned properties and events, and support fulfillment of sponsor entitlements, advertising commitments, and requests for information

**Community Relations**

- Liaise with office clients to support marketing goals around added amenities and activations.
- Assist in identifying and targeting appropriate community partners for mutually beneficial activations.

**General**

- Work with Marketing & Property Management team for development of annual budget. Report on quarterly forecast and variance.
- Provide support for regional marketing initiatives as assigned.

**Region/Building Specific Functions:**

- Perform other duties as assigned.

**Requirements and Qualifications:**

- A BA/BS degree in Marketing, Communications or related field required.
- A minimum of 2-5 years of experience in marketing communications, administrative support or property management required with social media and event management experience.
- Excellent oral and written communications skills.
- Knowledge of basic web design, graphic design, analytics, and desktop publishing programs preferred. (Word Press, Adobe Creative Suite)
- Ability to create timelines, exceed deadlines and juggle many projects simultaneously.
- Ability to work independently, as well as part of a team.
- Creativity and ability to initiate ideas and develop programs.
- Flexibility with work schedule as work on nights and weekends is required when marketing events are occurring or are requiring preparation.
- Experience in providing direction to external designers, printers, and other vendors.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Applications.

**Physical Requirements:**

- Involves work of a general office nature usually performed sitting such as operation of a computer.
- Involves work of a general office nature usually performed standing such as operation of a fax and printer.
- Involves work such as tours and onsite event execution throughout property portfolio usually performed by standing, walking, and by climbing stairs.
- Involves movement between departments to facilitate work.

**Internal and External Contacts:**

- Regularly interfaces both verbally and in writing, with tenant contacts, with the leasing, construction, development and financial teams as well as external vendors, construction professionals, consultants, and with the general public.

**Reporting Structure:**

- This position reports to the Director of Regional Marketing

**Salary Range:**

$75,915 - $105,585. BXP offers a competitive total rewards package including base salary and annual discretionary bonus. The range represents expected base salary; compensation will be determined based on role, skills, experience, qualifications, location, and other job-related factors. Additional details will be provided during the hiring process.

# Marketing Coordinator

$38 - $52 per hour

Sandbox Industries

[South San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/South-San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-7061169399643035943?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7512&pageType=7&jobAge=42&jdpSource=101&jdpid=6351412904349506374&crId=US_0US_0)

About Us:

Culture’s mission is to simplify and accelerate bioprocess development to enable our customers to bring their biopharmaceutical products to market faster.

With a focus on upstream cell culture process development, Culture has developed a unique platform that merges products, services and data management that can be applied to mammalian, microbial and viral vector production processes. This platform enables high-throughput process development projects to be rapidly and seamlessly executed directly by our customers in their own facilities, in our service laboratories, or both, all driven by our cloud-connected web application, accessible from anywhere, for designing, managing and analyzing experiments.

At Culture, we combine our passions for biomanufacturing, engineering, and operations to build new solutions that make bioprocess development faster. We value curiosity, communication, collaboration, a customer focused mindset and a drive for results.

The Opportunity:
Culture Biosciences is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Marketing Coordinator, Contractor to support the day-to-day execution of Culture’s marketing programs. This role will work closely with the Marketing Director and provide hands-on support across marketing campaigns, creative production, website updates, and vendor coordination.

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to build broad experience in marketing within a fast-moving biotechnology company.

What You’ll Do:

Marketing Campaigns & HubSpot

Set up and support email and digital marketing campaigns in HubSpot.

Build emails, landing pages, forms, lists, and basic workflows based on established campaign plans.

Coordinate campaign assets, links, deadlines, and launch requirements..

Pull basic campaign performance reports and help organize results.

Creative & Marketing Support

Assist with graphic layout and production of marketing materials, including brochures, presentations, one-pagers, social graphics, and trade show materials.

Make updates and revisions to existing marketing assets while maintaining Culture’s visual brand standards.

Work with the Marketing Director and external designers or creative partners to prepare marketing materials.

Help organize and maintain marketing files, templates, and brand assets.

Website & Digital Content

Make routine updates to website pages, images, links, and other content.

Publish and update landing pages and digital marketing content.

Assist with keeping website content accurate, current, and consistent with Culture’s messaging and brand.

Vendor & Budget Support

Coordinate with marketing vendors on project details, deliverables, timelines, and invoices.

Track marketing expenses and maintain accurate budget and spending records.

Coordinate with vendors and Accounts Payable to ensure invoices are submitted and processed correctly.

Assist with purchase orders, vendor documentation, and other marketing-related administrative tasks.

Provide regular updates to the Marketing Director on marketing spend and outstanding invoices.

Team Support

Work closely with the Marketing Director to keep marketing projects organized and on schedule.

Coordinate with internal teams and external vendors to gather information and complete assigned projects.

Manage assigned tasks independently and communicate proactively about priorities and deadlines.

Provide general marketing support as priorities evolve.

About You:

1-3 years of experience in marketing, marketing operations, communications, or a related field; relevant internship or equivalent experience considered.

Experience with HubSpot or another marketing automation/CRM platform preferred.

Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

Comfortable managing multiple projects and deadlines.

Basic experience with graphic design or layout tools such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.

Experience updating websites or working with a CMS is a plus.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets, budgets, invoices, and vendor information.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to learn new software and processes quickly.

Self-motivated, reliable, and willing to jump in wherever needed.

Interest in biotechnology, life sciences, or technology is a plus.

Location & Schedule:

This is an onsite, 6 month contract position based in South San Francisco, CA.

Approximately 10-15 hours per week.

Base Hourly Range :

Culture Biosciences offers market-competitive compensation. Our expected hourly rate range for this contractor role is $38 - $52 per hour. Final rates may vary within the range provided based on experience, expertise, qualifications, and other factors.

Culture Biosciences provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants. We seek to build a company that promotes inclusion and expands the diversity of our industry as a whole. We encourage people with identities underrepresented in biotech and technology to apply.

# Partner Marketing Specialist

WEKA LLC

[San Francisco, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/San-Francisco%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/2934265531279743934?p=1&pos=0&rgn=7429&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=1855769451390065810&crId=US_0US_0)

The Future of AI is Still Being Written.
This is Your Chance to Shape It.

WEKA is the AI data and memory infrastructure company transforming how organizations build, run, and scale AI. NeuralMesh™ combines high-performance data storage and extended GPU memory in a single software platform, providing a foundation for training, inference, and agentic AI workloads that maximizes GPU productivity, accelerates AI outcomes, and improves the economics of AI at scale.

WEKA is a pre-IPO, growth-stage company backed by world-class venture capital investors and AI infrastructure leaders. Our technology is trusted by 30% of the Fortune 50, as well as leading hyperscalers, neoclouds, AI builders, and research organizations. Our team is customer-obsessed, accountable, bold, and collaborative, with a shared focus on helping customers succeed. If we sound like your kind of people, join us!

About The Role
WEKA's partner ecosystem - spanning NVIDIA, cloud and neocloud providers, Tech Alliances, OEMs, and channel partners - is woven directly into how our field teams go to market. Rather than running partner marketing as a separate function, we integrate partner motions into our regional field campaign execution and product marketing. We're looking for a Partner Marketing Specialist to be the operational & executional layer of that integrated motion: managing MDF end-to-end, executing joint webinars, events, campaigns, and communications, keeping our partner-facing channels current, and serving as the shared partner-marketing execution resource for field marketing managers across AMS, EMEA, and APJ.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Campaigns and Growth Marketing, you'll ensure partner motions plug directly into WEKA's demand generation engine rather than running alongside it. Field marketing managers own the partner relationships and partner strategy in their regions; you're the execution layer that keeps joint work moving with partner counterparts. You'll work daily with field & partner marketing managers, alliances, partner field teams, finance, and partner contacts, and you'll collaborate closely with the partner product marketing team who owns joint positioning, narratives, and content strategy to help drive execution into the market This is a high-ownership execution role with visibility across the full partner-influenced GTM motion.

Who We're Looking For
You're an operator. You take pride in running many work streams in parallel without dropping balls - an MDF claim closing out while a webinar goes live and a portal updates ships. You bring structure to processes that involve money, external stakeholders, and deadlines, and people trust you with them because you're organized, responsive, and auditable.

You write clear, professional communications, you represent WEKA well with partner marketing counterparts, and you know how to keep external stakeholders moving without owning the relationship - regional field marketing managers own their partner relationships; you will help drive the execution across the teams

You also understand that partner marketing only matters if it fills the pipeline. You connect every MDF dollar, webinar, and campaign back to primarily marketing sourced, however also track influenced opportunities, and you flag what's working - and what isn't - to the field and campaign teams you support.

What You'll Be Working On

MDF Management: Own the Marketing Development Fund lifecycle end-to-end - proposal intake, approval routing, budget tracking, proof-of-execution collection, and claims and reimbursement - working with Finance, Alliances, and partner counterparts to keep utilization high and every dollar auditable.

Field & Partner Execution Support: Serve as the central partner-marketing execution resource for regional field marketing managers - fulfilling joint campaign requests, coordinating MDF-funded activities in-region, and ensuring partner motions are embedded consistently in field plans across AMS, EMEA, and APJ. Align with the field team to support events and logistics where appropriate.

Quarterly Regional Partner Webinar: Coordinate a standing one-to-many partner webinar in each region every quarter, open to all partner types - sourcing content from field marketing managers (regional plans), the Global Events Director (event calendar), and the Senior Campaign Director (campaign narrative), and running production, promotion, and follow-up end-to-end.

Webinars: Work with product marketing and field marketing to identify additional joint partner webinars end-to-end: scheduling, speaker coordination, registration setup, promotion, dry runs, live production, and post-event follow-up and lead routing.

Email & Communications: Build and send partner newsletters, campaign emails, and enablement announcements; maintain partner distribution lists and the partner communications calendar. Keep the partner portal current - publishing new assets, campaigns-in-a-box, incentive announcements, and enablement content; monitor usage and flag gaps. In addition establish a regular cadence to keep internal teams informed of partner activities and outcomes

Product Marketing Collaboration: Partner with the Senior Product Marketing Manager, Partners & Ecosystem on joint solution launches, co-branded content production, and partner-facing messaging rollouts - turning positioning and content strategy into in-market execution.

Qualifications

2-4 years of experience in marketing, with at least 1 year in partner, channel, or field marketing in enterprise technology.

Demonstrated ability to run budget-tracked processes with external stakeholders; direct experience with MDF or co-op programs is a strong plus.

Strong project management instincts, with the ability to run many parallel workstreams accurately and on deadline.

Hands-on experience with a marketing automation platform (Marketo or similar), a CRM (Salesforce), and webinar tooling.

Clear, professional written communication - this role is partner-facing daily.

Comfort working across time zones with regional marketers and partner contacts.

Experience with partner portal administration (Impartner, Salesforce PRM, or similar) is a plus..

Bachelor's degree in a relevant business or technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Located in North America with the ability to travel up to 15%.

How We Work: The WEKA Way

We are Accountable: We take full ownership, always, even when things don't go as planned. We lead with integrity, show up with responsibility and ownership, and hold ourselves and each other to the highest standards.

We are Brave: We question the status quo, push boundaries, and take smart risks when needed. We welcome challenges and embrace debates as opportunities for growth, turning courage into fuel for innovation.

We are Collaborative: True collaboration isn't only about working together. It's about lifting one another up to succeed collectively. We are team-oriented and communicate with empathy and respect. We challenge each other, resolve conflict constructively, and are transparent about our goals and the results we achieve. Together, we're unstoppable.

We are Customer Centric: Our customers are at the heart of everything we do. We actively listen and prioritize their success, and every decision we make is driven by how we can better serve, support, and empower them to succeed. When our customers win, we win.

United Truck Centers

### Job Description

Job Description

United Truck Centers, a leading Full Service Isuzu Truck Dealership in the automotive industry, is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Bookkeeper, Accountant, Office Manager to join our growing team. As the Bookkeeper Office Manager, you will play a crucial role in ensuring accurate financial records are maintained, managing office operations, and providing administrative support to the team. This is a fantastic opportunity to work with a trusted industry leader that offers stability, advancement opportunities, and a supportive work environment.

At United Truck Centers, we pride ourselves on being a family-owned business while also providing the benefits of an established national entity. With over 32 years of experience, we have become the largest independent fleet maintenance company in the San Fernando Valley. Our team of professionals works diligently to keep our clients' commercial and private fleet vehicles in excellent condition, making us a long-term strategic partner for fleet management and repair needs. We are driven by our commitment to customer service, innovation, and collaboration.

As our Bookkeeper Office Manager, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing accounts payable and receivable, processing payroll, preparing financial reports, and assisting in budgeting and forecasting. In addition, you will oversee office operations, including managing office supplies, coordinating appointments, organizing meetings, and providing administrative support to the team.

If you are a detail-oriented individual with strong organizational and communication skills, and you thrive in a fast-paced environment, then this role is for you. Join our talented team at United Truck Centers and be part of our continued success!

Responsibilities

##### Help Group Job Opportunity

Salary Range: $22.94 - $24.94

If you are driven by a desire to make a meaningful difference in your community and shape brighter futures, Help Group is the organization for you! We're one of the largest nonprofits of our kind in the U.S., offering diverse programs for individuals and families affected by autism spectrum disorder, ADHD, developmental delays, abuse, mental health and social-emotional challenges. Since our founding in 1975, we've grown significantly, expanding our reach to meet the evolving needs of our community. Today, we offer unparalleled academic programs, mental health support, therapy, life coaching, vocational training, specialized social and residential programs, and resources for LGBTQ+ youth and families. These initiatives touch the lives of over 6,000 clients a year and continue to expand in reach and impact. At the heart of Help Group's mission is a steadfast commitment to empowering individuals to reach their full potential and live positive, productive, and fulfilling lives. We invite passionate professionals to join us in supporting the development of our students, clients, and residents as we grow! Here, you'll find not just a job, but an opportunity to grow your career in a deeply rewarding environment!

Come be part of a team dedicated to empowering adolescents, adults and families facing mental health, social and emotional challenges because everyone deserves a great future. Through strategic partnerships with governmental agencies and innovative programs like Outpatient Services (OP), Hopeful Beginnings and REACH we foster long-term skills and support systems, enhancing the well-being of individuals and families across all stages of life.

Position Details:

- Full Time
- Location: Van Nuys

Key Responsibilities:

- Client care coordination - monitor the entrance and exit of clients in the Outpatient Department and Reception; greeting and check in of clients; provide information, when needed
- Greet and check in all clients and family members, provide information, when needed
- Maintain strict confidentiality of client
- Assist Psychiatrists with appointment scheduling (including reminder calls) and support for medication services. Translation services for psychiatric intakes and follow up appointments
- Provide administrative support to Outpatient Department and operations
- Relay all messages to appropriate parties
- Update phone lists and communicate staff changes to Admin, HR, Payroll
- Assist with intake procedures, phone screenings, transfers, grievance protocols
- Oversee maintenance and repair of copy machine. Fax machine and phones
- Administer and track OP DMH program client surveys throughout the year
- Assist with data entry related to case assignment outcomes information and tracking.
- Assist with filing Psychiatrist billing logs and notes in charts
- Schedule conference rooms, assist with meeting preparation
- Ensured all employees are issued a labeled mailbox
- Maintain and order supplies
- Other duties as assigned

Qualifications:

- High School diploma or equivalent.
- Minimum three years of office experience, computer proficiency, accurate typing skills; strong organization and time management skills.
- Ability to work with people of diverse cultural, educational, socio-economic, and linguistic backgrounds.
- Strong communication skills; customer service experience preferred.
- Bilingual in Spanish required.
- Translation experience preferred.

Benefits:

- Insurance plans for Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance - options for 100% employer sponsored plans
- 403b Retirement Plan
- 529 College Savings Plan
- Employee Assistance Program
- Flexible Spending Account

## Office Coordinator

The Office Coordinator position is responsible for oversight of the Western staff telecommute site. The role is responsible for managing the daily operations including opening and closing the office, ensuring the office has sufficient office and kitchen supplies, answering the phones, and assisting staff as needed. The position may require local travel during work schedule and overtime as needed.

Responsibilities Overview:

- Responsible for opening the 2221 Western Office at 7:45am, which includes turning off the security alarm, and preparing for staff arrivals.
- Responsible for closing the facility at 5pm which includes turning off lights and closing blinds and activating the alarm system for the facility. It's possible a Program Manager will close the office if their staff work late.
- Responsible for greeting staff members and being mindful of who is in the building.
- Responsible for participating in the receptionist pool to answer and route calls between the main offices and the satellite offices.
- Responsible for submitting kitchen supply orders to Purchasing Coordinator. Duties to include, receiving and stocking of supplies when received from external vendors. Inter-office supplies coordination will be required as warranted.
- Responsible for receiving all shipments to the office and ensuring they are delivered to the appropriate staff or location. Duties include maintaining copies of office supply packing slips and submitting them to the Purchasing Coordinator.
- Responsible for receiving, sorting, and delivering inter-office mail and US postal incoming mail. Also, ensure outgoing mail has postage and ensure the meter has an ample balance.
- Responsible for reporting maintenance issues (work order tracking system) to the appropriate parties responsible for coordinating the repairs)
- The position at the sole discretion of South Central Los Angles Regional Center, may assign other responsibilities and duties without notice.

Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education and/or Experience: High school diploma or general education degree (GED), plus four years of related experience and/or training including public contact; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Must be able to type 35-45 wpm; read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. MUST BE BILINGUAL (ENGLISH/SPANISH).

Language Skills: Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of organizations.

Mathematical Skills: Ability to add and subtract two digit numbers and to multiply and divide with 10's and 100's. Ability to perform these operations using units of American money and weight measurement, volume, and distance.

Reasoning Ability: Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out detailed but uninvolved written or oral instructions. Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.

Physical Demands: The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; and talk to hear. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds or more when warranted through the use of approved safety measures. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

ABOUT CITADEL CPM

Citadel CPM is a California corporation, headquartered in Pasadena with offices in Fullerton, Long Beach, Riverside, and Sacramento, as well as Phoenix, Arizona. Citadel was established in 2006 to provide professional construction project management services to Federal, State, and municipal agencies in the justice, corrections, education, healthcare, infrastructure, and military market sectors.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our team is dedicated to making our clients' vision a reality while delivering projects on budget, schedule, scope, and quality expectations. Our team is committed to resolving issues in a professional and collaborative manner with integrity always foremost in mind. We are proud to know that Citadel CPM is regarded as a team of reputable professionals that clients seek to help them manage their construction projects, and that industry professionals aspire to join. Citadel's reputation has been built on a set of three principles that form our core values: Integrity, Professionalism, and Responsiveness.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Citadel CPM is in search of a highly experienced Program Scheduler to join our team. In this role, you will be managing the program schedule for educational facilities project on Primavera (P6) within a team. You will monitor the Critical Path and Earned value throughout the projects.

ABOUT YOU

You are a professional with minimum of five (5) years of scheduling experience on P6 program for construction projects. You have maintained construction schedules to keep the project on time for the construction staff to stay on schedule.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

- Develops and maintains program schedules identifying relationships, logic, milestones, and constraints for construction projects of various types.
- Monitors and actively participates in project and program scheduling issues while administering best practices and standards.
- Obtains accurate and timely program schedule updates from project teams and performs QA/QC on information received.
- Creates and develops conceptual what-if schedules for multiple project types including large complex multi-year projects.
- Performs Critical Path analyses and Earned Value analyses.
- Prepares ad-hoc reports and analyses as directed by management.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Minimum of five (5) years full-time paid professional experience in scheduling for an Owner or General Contractor, preferably working on multiple educational facilities or public works projects.
- Proficiency in Primavera latest version and MS Office Suite.
- Experience with projects using Design-Bid-Build and Design-Build project delivery methods.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Superior organizational and planning skills.
- Ability to build efficient working relationships with project teams and department staff.

EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS

You must have one of the following:

- Graduation from a recognized college or university with a bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, or Construction Management.

OR

- Graduation from a recognized college or university with a bachelor's degree in any course of study, but with additional two (2) years of experience in Construction Scheduling to compensate for the required education.

$134k - $146k

Blue Stone Management

### Job Description

Job Description

**Scheduler II**

**Location:** Los Angeles County, CA

**Hybrid, 2 days remote**

**Salary Range**

**Scheduler II - $134,000 – $146,000**

**WHO WE ARE**

At Blue Stone Management, we're more than project and construction managers, we're trusted advisors, problem-solvers, and partners in delivering projects that make a difference.

From aviation and infrastructure to public facilities and complex capital improvement programs, we bring expertise, collaboration, and innovative thinking to every project we undertake.

We're looking for an experienced **Scheduler II** professional to join our team and support a significant disaster recovery and rebuilding initiative in Los Angeles County.

If you're a detail-oriented scheduling professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and enjoys managing complex, high-impact programs, we'd love to hear from you!

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

**Project Scheduling & Program Management**

- Develop, maintain, and update comprehensive project schedules from design through construction and closeout.
- Create critical path method (CPM) baseline schedules and manage regular updates to monitor project progress.
- Build and maintain an integrated master program schedule across multiple concurrent capital projects.
- Perform resource loading, cost loading, and earned value analysis to support project performance reporting.
- Identify critical milestones, scheduling conflicts, and potential delays that could impact project delivery.

**Schedule Analysis & Reporting**

- Review contractor baseline schedules, monthly updates, and recovery schedules to ensure compliance with contractual requirements.
- Prepare and evaluate time impact analyses, delay claims, and schedule recovery strategies.
- Assess external scheduling factors, including community meetings, concurrent partner agency activities, and funding requirements.
- Develop look-ahead schedules, milestone reports, schedule narratives, and executive-level progress summaries.
- Monitor schedule performance and recommend corrective actions to keep projects on track.

**Collaboration & Risk Management**

- Work closely with project managers, design consultants, contractors, and partner agencies to coordinate schedules and project milestones.
- Identify potential schedule risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize project delays.
- Present schedule updates, critical path analyses, and project progress reports to management and key stakeholders.
- Support project teams in managing competing priorities and adapting to evolving program requirements.

**WHAT YOU BRING**

- **Scheduler II:** Minimum **10 years of project scheduling experience** on public capital improvement or construction projects.
- **Minimum 5 years of experience** planning and scheduling public sector construction projects from design through construction and closeout.
- Educational background in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, or a related field.
- Demonstrated experience developing and managing CPM baseline schedules and integrated master schedules.
- Strong knowledge of construction sequencing, project controls, schedule analysis, and delay mitigation.
- Experience reviewing contractor schedules, analyzing delays, and preparing time impact analyses.
- Ability to manage scheduling requirements across multiple concurrent projects.
- Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, including presenting complex scheduling information to management and stakeholders.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing project priorities.

**TECHNICAL SKILLS**

- Advanced proficiency in **Primavera P6** and **Microsoft Project** .
- Expertise in Critical Path Method (CPM) scheduling, baseline development, and schedule updates.
- Experience with resource loading, cost loading, and earned value reporting.
- Ability to develop integrated master schedules, schedule narratives, and project performance dashboards.
- Proficiency in schedule risk assessments, time impact analyses, and delay evaluations.

**BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE**

- Experience supporting disaster recovery, rebuilding, or post-disaster capital improvement programs.
- Experience managing schedules for large-scale, multi-project public works programs.
- Familiarity with public/government agencies.

**WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE**

At Blue Stone Management, we believe great projects start with great people. You'll have the opportunity to:

- **Make a difference:** Contribute to a major rebuilding initiative that supports community recovery and long-term infrastructure improvements.
- **Work on impactful projects:** Support a diverse portfolio of capital projects with a combined estimated value of approximately $800 million.
- **Collaborate with industry professionals:** Work alongside experienced project managers, engineers, consultants, and public agency partners.
- **Take ownership:** Play a key role in developing scheduling strategies that drive successful project delivery.

_Blue Stone Management is an equal opportunity employer_

Position Summary
The Administrative Assistant provides high quality secretarial, technical, and organizational support to lawyers and managerial staff, as assigned. This is a dynamic position requiring professionalism, effective communication skills, and sound judgment, with a thorough understanding of the Firm’s policies. Additionally, this position requires attention to detail and superior customer service skills. The Administrative Assistant is a valued member of the support team, contributing to the overall success of the practice and department.

Enter attorney time and reimbursable expenses.
Prepare client bills, track payments, and work in tandem with billing coordinators
Assist with year-end activities and collections
Develop knowledge of practice groups and their operations.

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong organizational skills, able to prioritize tasks and manage multiple responsibilities.
Capable of adapting work styles to varied situations and principals’ preferences.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite; strong technical skills required.
High attention to detail with strong proofreading, data entry, and recordkeeping skills; ensure follow-through on tasks and deadlines.
Professionalism and discretion in handling sensitive information; represent the Firm positively and respectfully.
Proactive problem-solver with initiative; anticipate needs and resolve issues resourcefully.
High standards of work ethic and personal integrity.
Dependable, responsive, and disciplined, inspiring confidence and credibility.
Collaborative team player; work effectively with internal departments and clients to foster a positive and cohesive work environment.
Contribute value to the practice floor support team and department.
Maintain awareness of industry trends.
Actively contributes with team-related activities and other knowledge-sharing activities including mentoring to ensure first-class service while away or out of office.

Education and/or Experience
Associate Degree or higher
1 to 5 years’ experience as an administrative assistant or paralegal
