# Administrative Specialist - Onsite (Los Angeles, CA)

$28 per hour

Universal Strategic Advisors, LLC

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/6869671973925384176?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=90&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-262502497040593429&crId=US_0US_0)

Administrative Specialist – Onsite – \[Los Angeles, CA\] Universal Strategic Advisors LLC (US Advisors) is a small business consulting firm. We specialize in government administration, technology implementation, law enforcement operations, homeland security, immigration operations, border security and compliance. We give our federal clients deep subject-matter expertise and a trusted network so they can meet mission demands while managing risk.
Position Summary US Advisors is hiring a highly organized, detail-oriented Administrative Specialist to provide onsite administrative, data and program support to U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) within the Los Angeles Area of Responsibility (AOR). The Administrative Specialist supports office operations and the processes for individuals in ICE custody and individuals reporting to ICE offices. The work includes documentation, data management, reporting and general administrative support for agency personnel. The ideal candidate is bilingual in English and Spanish, analytical and dependable, and able to manage several priorities at once while maintaining strict confidentiality.
Responsibilities Administrative documentation: Prepare, organize and maintain administrative records related to office processing, and file documents electronically following established procedures.
Data entry and data management: Enter, validate and update information accurately in designated government systems, and keep data complete, current, and consistent flagging discrepancies or missing information for resolution..
Data reporting: Monitor key data points and prepare recurring and ad hoc reports, trackers and summaries for office leadership.
Appointment scheduling and tracking: Schedule, check and track appointments, and see that the related paperwork and notices are prepared and filed on time.
Program management support: Provide administrative and documentation support for office initiatives, and recommend process improvements based on observed workflow and data trends.
Communications and taskings support: Support taskings, data calls, travel authorizations and itineraries, and other communications initiatives as defined by supervisors.
Budget support: Help track budgets, expenditures and related reporting.
Document control and compliance: Maintain organized physical and electronic files, and follow all applicable confidentiality, privacy and records-handling requirements.
Front-office and clerical support: Assist individuals reporting to the office with professionalism and courtesy, and give general clerical support to ICE personnel as directed.
Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution.
At least three years of professional experience in administrative support, data management, program support or a related field.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint), including working with data in Excel, and comfort learning new software systems.
Experience entering, maintaining and reporting data with a high degree of accuracy.
Comfort working in a customer-facing, public-service setting.
U.S. citizenship.
Ability to pass and keep a federal background investigation.
Preferred Qualifications Fluent in English and Spanish in a professional setting (optional).
Experience supporting a federal, state or local government agency, particularly in law enforcement or immigration operations.
Experience with budget tracking, travel coordination or program management support.
Experience training, mentoring or coordinating the work of other staff.
Strong organizational, analytical and time-management skills.
Clear, professional written and verbal communication.
A high level of discretion, professionalism and attention to detail.
Work Schedule and Location This position is fully onsite at the ICE office in the greater Los Angeles metropolitan area.
The role follows a shift schedule requiring at least 40 hours of work per week between 7:00 AM and 7:00 PM local time, including weekends and holidays.
Background Investigation Each offer is contingent on passing a federal background investigation, which includes a criminal history check and verification of employment history, education and other information the agency requires. Passing the investigation is a condition of employment.
Compensation $28.00per hour
Benefits Health and wellness benefits for eligible employees
Paid time off for sick leave and vacation
Paid federal holidays

# Clinic Administrative Coordinator

Kheir Clinic

[Los Angeles, CA](https://jooble.org/jobs/Los-Angeles%2C-CA)

[Apply](https://jooble.org/away/-5668695058429637168?p=1&pos=0&rgn=6546&pageType=7&jobAge=186&jdpSource=101&jdpid=-6501057564829509347&crId=US_0US_0)

### Job Description

Job Description

**ASSIGNMENT SUMMARY**

The Clinic Administrative Coordinator will be responsible for providing administrative support that affects direct operational and/or patient care services. This person will also provide assistance with front office duties including clinic reception and medical record keeping when necessary. They must be highly proficient in Microsoft Office programs and other computer functions in order to maintain detailed records.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES**

•Provides comprehensive administrative support services to the Clinic Directors that ensures aprofessional, responsive and effective experience with the organization as a whole.

•Records and transcribes meeting minutes, prepares meeting agendas and keeps project logsaccurate and up-to-date.

•Possesses information technology acuity to learn and use various software applications.

•Types memorandums, letters and other documents as required by project staff.

•Completes any necessary administrative tasks, such as research, maintaining files,typing/drafting reports and managing correspondences from project team members.

•Receives incoming calls, delivers voicemails, and provides responses to telephone inquiries inrelation to clinic services and employees.

•Scheduling appointments, management of emails & faxes.

•Capturing any scheduling errors with patient appointments.

•Provides sophisticated organization and calendar management.

•Prioritizes inquiries and requests while troubleshooting conflicts with little guidance; makesjudgments and recommendations to ensure smooth day-to-day engagements. Schedulesinternal and external meetings. Handles logistics for internal meetings.

•Plans, organizes, and schedules meetings in the office, off-site, and via videoconference

•Formats and word processes correspondence, reports, forms, etc., including proofreading andediting.

•Prepares accurate information of required daily visit reports, survey logs, Spore test results andother requested reports, as needed.

•Maintains and tracks invoice receipts.

•Maintains cash logs and submits daily cash and checks to the accounting department

•Represents management staff at meetings and takes notes as needed.

•Prepares presentations and/or reports for monthly staff meetings.

•Assist in scheduling interviews and onboarding new employees

•Be a site contact person as needed for patient service recovery.

•Documentation maintenance as it relates to licensing, permits, etc.

•Responsible for stocking necessary supplies for the clinic.

•Collects and Prepares employee’s timesheets, in a timely manner.

•Reports facility problems, IT issues, and/or unsolved problem to appropriate individual

•Coordinates administrative workflow of the department; recommends new processes asneeded.

•Interacts daily with employees to discuss standard business policy and procedures.

•Participates in the safety committee meetings and Human Resources events.

•Performs other department specific duties as assigned.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

•Bachelor’s Degree preferred

•A minimum of two-year experience in an office environment performing a similar level of workrequired.

•Prior health care experience preferred.

•Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

•Ability to work under pressure without extensive supervision.

•Ability to learn and apply an advanced understanding of the organization and its functionalpolicies and processes.

•Ability to manage dynamic calendars for management.

•Aptitude for learning new software and systems (i.e. eClinicalWorks)

•Advanced writing skills to compose detailed correspondence and to recommend updates todepartment documents as needed.

•Intermediate to advanced knowledge of two or more of Microsoft Office Suite applications:Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

•Excellent written and verbal communication skills

•Exceptional time management and organizational skills

•Computer skills, including email, Microsoft Office (Excel) & data tracking

•Ability to work quickly, follow directions and make independent decisions

•Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling patient medical records

•Ability to address patient service issues as needed and assigned by Clinic Director

•Experience in community clinic environment a plus

•Valid California driver license and insurable driving record required
